description.en: Keeps long DSH sessions alive when a model channel starts failing: daruma takes over after the in-box retry gives up, trips a self-healing circuit breaker on…
description.zh: 渠道开始失败时不让长任务中断：内置重试放弃后 daruma 接管，对连续 429/5xx 或终止性错误跳闸自愈断路器，把下一个请求切到链上的其他渠道。支持 DSH 0.1.x 与 0.2.x 宿主，含已实测故障转移与备用管理 RPC 的 0.2.1-rc.2。备用渠道可在设置页或输入框旁的面板挑选，两处即时同步；每次切…

description.en: Bidi-safe RTL rendering for mixed Arabic and English text, a full Arabic interface pack (3,307 strings) registered through the DSH locale service, and three…
description.zh: 让 DSH 界面说阿拉伯语：混合阿拉伯文与英文的双向文本排版，通过 DSH 官方语言服务注册完整阿拉伯语界面包（3,307 条），并内置三款 thmanyah 字体（界面 Sans、正文 Serif Text、标题 Serif Display），置于应用自身字体设置之后。

description.en: Bring a DSH plugin repository's build and release pipeline into the app: a sidebar panel listing each repository's latest workflow run, its releases, and how…
description.zh: 把 DSH 插件仓库的持续构建与发布搬进应用：侧边栏面板逐仓库显示最近一次工作流运行、已发布与草稿 Release，以及本地检出相对上次发布的领先与未提交情况，并提供触发构建、发布、公开草稿、重跑、取消、查失败日志等按钮。通过本机已登录的 gh CLI 驱动工作流，插件自身不保存任何凭据，被监视的仓库列表放在配置文件里…

description.en: Run one deterministic skill-routing pass on every user instruction, so the skill catalog is consulted before the model answers instead of after it remembers.…
description.zh: 对每条用户指令自动做一次确定性的技能路由，让技能目录在模型作答之前就被查阅，而不是等它自己想起来。宿主侧只依据指令关键词与目录元数据打分，不调用 LLM 也不做向量检索，然后向该步追加恰好一条带生产者标签的消息：默认是候选排名简报，分数过线时改注入冠军技能的 SKILL.md…

description.en: Audible feedback for the DSH web interface: button presses are classified by semantics (normal, primary, toggle, send, close, danger, link) and the current…
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 界面补上可听的语义反馈：按钮按下按语义分类发声（普通、主要、开关、发送、关闭、危险、链接），当前会话的任务开始、成功结束、失败结束以及出现待处理交互也各有一声，每个情景都能在设置页单独挑音效、单独开关。78 个 cue 与 12 个音色包全部由浏览器用 Web Audio API…

description.en: Codex-backed `web_search`, `image_gen`, and `image_vision` tools for DeepSeek Harness, reusing ChatGPT OAuth login state.
description.zh: 基于 Codex 的 `web_search`、`image_gen` 与 `image_vision` 工具，复用 ChatGPT OAuth 登录态为 DeepSeek Harness 提供网页搜索、生图与识图能力。

description.en: Windows desktop control through UI Automation, window screenshots and mouse/keyboard input, with per-session app consent and action approvals.
description.zh: 通过 UI Automation、窗口截图和鼠标键盘操作 Windows 桌面软件，支持会话独立应用授权和操作审批。

description.en: CalDAV calendar tools (list/create/update/delete/search/health) for Google/iCloud/Nextcloud/custom endpoints, with RRULE expansion, a month/week/agenda panel…
description.zh: CalDAV 日历插件：查/建/改/删/搜日程与健康自检，Google/iCloud/Nextcloud/自定义端点，RRULE 重复事件展开；设置页内置月/周/议程面板，连接可在面板内填写并先测后存，周视图支持拖拽改期（15 分钟吸附、5 秒撤销）。面板内置 4 步首次使用引导，看一次后不再出现。

description.zh: 独立于常规客户端插件加载链的 DSH Web 启动救援工具，可定位疑似故障插件、临时跳过，并且只恢复 Boot Guard 写入的配置。

description.en: Reports which skills each turn invoked (loaded by the model, typed as /name, or none) and manages the local skill directory: install from a pasted repository,…
description.zh: 每轮对话报告本轮调用了哪些 skill（模型自动加载、用户输入 /name，或一个都没用），并管理本机 skill 目录：粘贴仓库、文件夹、SKILL.md 或 zip 地址即可安装，中文显示名写入该 skill 的 meta.yaml，删除时保留备份。

description.en: An Obsidian-style knowledge base: ingest sources, let the LLM build and maintain an interlinked wiki, and ask questions grounded in it.
description.zh: 一个 Obsidian 风格的知识库：摄取资料，让 LLM 构建并维护互联 wiki，并基于它提问。

description.en: Plugin center for VibeDev: describes the official VibeDev plugins and installs them in one click through the plugin manager (inspect, install disabled, then…
description.zh: VibeDev 插件中心：介绍 VibeDev 官方插件，并通过官方插件管理器一键安装（先检查、先不启用地安装、再启用，并带上前置依赖）。另提供套装安装、旧包名迁移，以及一键安装插件市场 dshmarket。

description.en: Measures design rules on the rendered page rather than in the CSS — type-scale count, WCAG AA contrast against the real composited backdrop, spacing-grid…
description.zh: 在渲染后的页面上测量设计规则，而非解析 CSS——字号种类、与真实合成背景比对的 WCAG AA 对比度、间距栅格偏移、配色规模、点击区尺寸，以及「机器味指纹」（如按色相角度判定的紫色渐变）；内置 design-system 技能。

description.en: Browser operation by accessibility refs: navigate, snapshot the page as a ref tree, act on elements, and wait for conditions; the origin policy follows the…
description.zh: 按无障碍 ref 操控浏览器：导航、把页面快照成 ref 树、操作元素、等待条件；域名策略跟随会话审批状态，并由请求拦截层强制执行。

description.en: Headless-browser verification tools so the agent opens the page it just built, reads the rendered DOM and computed styles, checks the console, and screenshots…
description.zh: 无头浏览器验证工具：让 agent 打开自己刚写的页面，读取渲染后的 DOM 与计算样式、检查控制台、截图留档；内置 frontend-verify 技能。

description.en: Adversarial code review — parallel finders inspect a diff through separate lenses (correctness, lifecycle, contract, security), then each finding goes to…
description.zh: 对抗式代码审查：多个 finder 并行地从不同视角（正确性、生命周期、契约、安全）审查改动，随后每条发现都交给独立验证者去推翻它，只要有一票推翻就丢弃。

description.en: OpenCode free models for DSH with dynamic model-list refresh, optional HTTP(S)/SOCKS proxy failover, a fail-closed tool bridge and offline agent-scoped…
description.zh: 在 DSH 中使用 OpenCode 免费模型，支持模型列表动态刷新与可选的代理出口轮换，并提供默认拒绝不安全转换的工具桥与离线、按 Agent 作用域的兼容性审计。

description.en: Zotero as an evidence store for agents: search your library, inspect metadata and notes, retrieve evidence passages, open source PDFs, and generate citations…
description.zh: 面向 Agent 研究工作流的 Zotero 插件：搜索文献、查看元数据与笔记、提取与问题相关的证据段落、打开原文 PDF、生成引用与参考文献表。

description.en: Turns a dsh session into a redacted idea and delivers it end-to-end encrypted to friends on DeepHub; received ideas land as new sessions.
description.zh: 将一条 dsh 会话提炼为脱敏后的思路，端到端加密投递给 DeepHub 上的朋友；收到的思路落为一条新会话。

description.en: A Gemini kitten widget for the DSH Web UI: live Google Gemini API free-tier quota per model, a model switcher, color-coded warnings, drag-to-snap, and…
description.zh: DSH Web 界面的 Gemini 猫娘额度挂件：每个模型的 Gemini API 免费层配额实时显示、按型号切换、按额度变色预警、拖拽吸附、点击换台词。

description.en: ChatGPT-style side chat for the DSH Web GUI: ask small questions about the current topic in a floating side panel, answered by an independent lightweight…
description.zh: ChatGPT 式侧边快速提问：在 DSH Web 聊天界面右侧悬浮面板中就当前话题提小问题，由独立轻量会话通过官方 /api RPC 回答，绝不写入、不影响主对话。流式正文、可折叠思考、工具 chips、停止按钮、agent 预设选择，自动抓取主对话最近内容作为背景。

description.en: Per-turn and per-session estimated cost in the DSH Web UI, computed from provider-reported token usage in four buckets with the built-in official DeepSeek CNY…
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 界面显示每轮与整个会话的预估费用：按 provider 上报的 token 用量（四桶）与内置官方 DeepSeek 人民币峰谷价目计价，高峰为北京时间周一至周五 9:00–12:00、14:00–18:00，周末与中国法定节假日全天按空闲价；可用本机费率表叠加其它或自部署模型的单价，没有单价的模型…

description.en: Adds file and folder drag-and-drop attachments to the Web UI, with composer cards, persistent history, and workspace-backed paths.
description.zh: 为 Web UI 添加文件与文件夹拖放附件，提供输入栏卡片、持久化历史记录与工作区路径。

description.en: Adds an input-modality selector to custom model settings in the DeepSeek Harness Web UI.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 的自定义模型设置添加输入模态选择器。

description.en: Interactive Side-Assistant Dock to ask quick side questions via /btw with real-time thinking status and history pagination without interrupting the active…
description.zh: 交互式侧边助手坞：用 /btw 快速提问，实时显示思考状态，历史记录分页浏览。

description.en: Free conversational ChatGPT Web (GPT 5.6 Luna) model provider for DeepSeek Harness with streaming Markdown.
description.zh: 基于免费 ChatGPT 网页端（GPT 5.6 Luna）的 DeepSeek Harness 零成本对话模型提供者，支持流式 Markdown。

description.en: Skill center panel for the DSH web GUI - search online skill registries (SkillHub, skills.sh, GitHub), install skills to user or project roots, and manage…
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 的技能中心面板——搜索网络技能市场（SkillHub、skills.sh、GitHub），一键安装技能到用户或项目根，并管理本地技能（启停、创建、编辑、删除、预览）。

description.en: Inject deployment-configured system-prompt sections and reference exchanges into every conversation request via stream interception, with a web settings panel.
description.zh: 通过流拦截将部署级系统提示词段落与参考对话注入每次对话请求，附带 Web 设置面板。

description.en: Use a ChatGPT/Codex subscription in DeepSeek Harness with GPT models, image generation, web search, subscription quota reporting, model and feature controls,…
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中使用 ChatGPT/Codex 订阅接入 GPT 模型、图像生成与 Web 搜索，并支持订阅额度显示、模型与功能控制，以及浏览器或设备码 OAuth 登录。

description.en: Endpoint of a companion mobile app that also runs headless, with no desktop shell or Electron required: it serves a restricted mobile API over a relay tunnel…
description.zh: 手机 App 的对端插件，自身可作无头宿主单独运行（不需要桌面外壳或 Electron）：经中转隧道或局域网配对提供受限的移动 API，用于列出、新建与操控 DSH 会话、订阅设备实时事件流，并以可吊销的设备凭据鉴权。

description.en: Manages archived DSH chats with conversation search, restore, and confirmed safe permanent deletion.
description.zh: 管理 DSH 归档聊天，支持聊天记录搜索、恢复和二次确认的安全永久删除。

description.en: ChatGPT OAuth provider for Codex models with subscription web search, quota and safe reset, image tools, Fast mode, and model-aware context; no API key or…
description.zh: 通过 ChatGPT OAuth 在 DSH 中使用 Codex 模型，提供订阅联网搜索、额度与安全重置、图片工具、高速模式和模型感知上下文；无需 API Key 或 Codex CLI。

description.en: Upgrades DSH image viewing with pointer-centered zoom, pan, galleries, downloads, keyboard support, and inline region notes.
description.zh: 增强 DSH 原生图片查看体验，支持指针中心缩放、拖动、画廊、下载、键盘操作和图片区域备注。

description.en: Adds a model-aware reasoning effort slider with native and animated modes, light and dark palettes, and shared or per-model colors.
description.zh: 为模型添加推理强度滑块，支持原生与动画模式、明暗配色，以及全局或按模型配色。

description.en: Reuses the sign-in already held by the local Doubao desktop app as a DeepSeek Harness model provider, and adds a read-only quota view for the 5-hour and weekly…
description.zh: 复用本机豆包桌面客户端已有的登录态，作为 DeepSeek Harness 的模型 provider，并提供 5 小时限额与周额度的只读额度概览。仅 Windows x64：凭据解密依赖 DPAPI。

description.en: Two-way Codex↔DSH bridge: skills from ~/.codex/skills, session import with workspace attach, live MCP mirroring of mcp_servers, and a Codex-side reverse MCP…
description.zh: Codex 与 DSH 双向桥接：挂载 ~/.codex/skills、带工作区绑定的会话导入、mcp_servers 实时镜像，以及 Codex 端反向 MCP 安装器。

description.en: Web search pool for the native web_search tool: fails over across 8 free/paid backends with quota-aware circuit breaking, settings-page API key management,…
description.zh: 原生 web_search 的搜索池：8 个免费/付费后端自动故障转移与额度感知熔断，设置页管理 API Key、自定义 SearXNG 实例、failover/rotate 策略切换与 SerpApi 实时额度查询。

description.en: Enable permessage-deflate on DSH's WebSocket transport without modifying the DSH install tree.
description.zh: 在不修改 DSH 安装目录的前提下，为 DSH 的 WebSocket 传输启用 permessage-deflate。

description.en: Teaching-first CTF solving skill: narrates each step's pattern, tool choice and underlying mechanism, then writes a reproducible writeup under…
description.zh: 教学式 CTF 解题技能：每步讲清套路、工具选型与底层原理，收尾在 solves/<题目名>/ 生成可复现 Writeup，并用九章质量门校验。

description.en: A conversational voice frontend Agent for dsh: speak naturally over ByteDance Duplex, delegate requests to background tasks, and hear their asynchronous…
description.zh: dsh 的对话式语音前端 Agent：通过 ByteDance Duplex 自然对话，把语音请求委派给后台任务，并用语音回报异步结果。

description.en: Turn-handoff reminders in the DSH Web UI with a modal or top banner, six browser-synthesized chimes, configurable auto-dismiss, and a sidebar speaker toggle…
description.zh: DSH Web 界面的回合交接提醒：居中弹窗或顶部横幅、六种浏览器合成提示音、可配置自动消失，以及带未读会话列表的侧栏喇叭开关。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: DietrichGebert/ponytail lazy senior mode & 7-rung ladder port, 6 skills with bilingual descriptions & per-skill toggles, zero tools,…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：DietrichGebert/ponytail 懒人 senior 模式与七阶梯子完美移植，6 个技能描述双语自由切换，各个技能自由开关，零 tool 注册，全场景零缓存破坏。

description.en: Claude Code-style prompt history, double-Esc picker, selection quote/copy & right-click paste.
description.zh: Claude Code 风格上下键历史回溯、双击 Esc 历史搜索、选中文本引用/自动复制与鼠标右键直接粘贴。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness plugin: 15 obra/superpowers engineering skills, bilingual descriptions, per-skill toggles.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 插件：15 个 obra/superpowers 工程纪律技能，技能描述中英双语自由切换，每一个技能本身自由开关。

description.en: Adds a checkbox-style switch at the right end of the Installed group header on the DSH Plugins page: it opens a checklist of the unofficial plugins, all…
description.zh: 在 DSH 插件页的「已安装」分组标题右端加一个勾选式开关：点开是当前方向下非官方插件的清单，默认全选，只切换你保留勾选的那些；全部停用后按钮翻转成启用侧。只做启用/停用，从不卸载插件、也不删除插件文件与配置，界面文案跟随应用语言。

description.en: Colors DSH sidebar Session rows by their official status, in an Evangelion-flavored palette: a blue left rail for a row awaiting interaction, red for the…
description.zh: 按官方状态给 DSH 侧栏会话行染色，配色取自福音战士：等你处理的会话为蓝色左轨，主视图打开的那条为红色左轨，已结束但未查看为紫色左轨，置顶行的标题为静态彩虹。左侧轨道按模式分档——暗档保留原色，亮档换成对浅底 ≥4.5:1 的压暗变体——分档读的是 DSH 自己的暗色标记；未读的紫色轨道两种模式共用。只读取官方…

description.en: PDF document editing plugin for precise text editing in PDF files.
description.zh: 面向 PDF 文档的编辑插件,精确编辑PDF文字

description.en: Sidebar skill hub: scan Claude/Codex/Cursor/Gemini skill directories for one-click import, manage global/project skills (toggle, trash), and install from…
description.zh: 侧边栏技能站：扫描 Claude/Codex/Cursor/Gemini 技能目录一键导入，管理全局与项目技能（启停、回收站），支持拖拽文件夹、zip 包与本地路径（不限大小）安装。

description.en: Enhanced workspace directory browser for the web UI: one-click access to /mnt Windows drives under WSL, full breadcrumb ancestry and an always-visible path…
description.zh: Web UI 增强版工作区目录选择器：WSL 下 /mnt Windows 盘符一键直达、完整面包屑层级与常显路径输入框。

description.en: Archives the sessions of a workspace when its folder is deleted or moved away, or when its registration is removed, and restores them when it returns:…
description.zh: 工作区文件夹被删除或移走、或工作区登记被移除时，自动归档其会话；目录或登记回归时恢复：只取消归档本插件归档过的会话，把台账记过的全部成员挂回分组（含你手动归档的会话，且不改其归档状态），并把「无项目」里工作目录正是该工作区路径的会话归位。

description.en: File-change monitor and code editor for the DSH Web UI. Agent edits appear beside your conversation as real-time line-by-line diffs, with a syntax-highlighted…
description.zh: DSH Web UI 的文件修改监视器与代码工作台。Agent 修改代码时实时浮现逐行 Diff，内置语法高亮编辑器，支持一键还原、修改历史、工作区切换与按会话隔离。

description.en: Android real-device debugging workbench for the DSH Web GUI: auto-attached logcat with severity/keyword filters and crash snapshots, live on-device screen…
description.zh: DSH Web GUI 安卓实机调试工作台：自动附加 logcat 流（级别/关键词过滤、崩溃自动快照），真机屏幕实时投屏与远程点击/滑动/文字操控，内存/进程/frida 逆向工具链，30 个 agent 工具。

description.en: Left-edge user-Turn navigation rail with reading-position highlighting, hover previews of per-turn metrics and model-answer excerpts, keyboard and…
description.zh: 左侧用户轮次导航轨道：随阅读位置高亮，悬停预览单轮指标与模型回答摘要，支持键盘和点击跳转及本地会话搜索。

description.en: Local, per-session LIFO prompt stash for temporarily setting aside unfinished composer text and safely restoring it later.
description.zh: 本地、按会话隔离的 LIFO 输入暂存：临时收起未完成的输入，之后安全恢复并继续编辑。

description.en: A better fold bar: automatically folds tool calls and Think segments into step fold bars, and collapses each finished turn into a single turn header with live…
description.zh: 更好的折叠栏：将工具调用与 Think 段自动折叠为步骤折叠栏，回合结束后整回合收拢为带实时指标（耗时/首字/token/tok/s/缓存命中）的回合折叠栏，只保留最终总结正文；前导图标可自定义，内置动态扑克牌（运行中花色循环卡牌动画、收起牌堆、展开扇形），提供官方折叠方式设置行，适配 DSH 新旧版本。零侵入…

description.en: Multi-candidate mode for DeepSeek Harness (test-time scaling): floating panel config, the agent auto-runs parallel candidates plus verifier selection, scoped…
description.zh: 多候选模式插件（test-time scaling）：悬浮球面板配置，模型对任务自动执行并行候选加验证选优，仅当前会话生效。

description.en: Renders image, video, and audio paths and URLs from DSH conversations inline, with workspace-confined local reads and an optional ComfyUI proxy.
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话中内联显示图像、视频和音频路径及 URL，并提供工作区受限的本地读取与可选的 ComfyUI 代理。

description.en: Matches prompts to installed skills for automatic activation, applies skill-declared lifecycle hooks and tool policies, and manages GitHub-hosted skills from…
description.zh: 根据提示词自动激活已安装的 Skill，应用 Skill 声明的生命周期 Hook 与工具策略，并通过设置页或 skill_manager 工具管理 GitHub 托管的 Skill。

description.en: Replaces the chat composer with an editor-style input panel on CodeMirror 6: line numbers, edit + markdown-preview split, a floating window mode and a…
description.zh: 把聊天输入框换成 CodeMirror 6 的编辑器式输入面板：行号、编辑 + Markdown 预览分屏、悬浮窗与全高侧栏标签，同一时刻只有一个输入入口。草稿走官方输入机；宿主有语音输入按钮时原样渲染官方语音组件，数据行与上下文小圈与官方 dock 同源。

description.en: Voice input plugin for DeepSeek Harness (dsh): a microphone button in the composer turns speech into a draft transcript, with a choice of speech-recognition…
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness (dsh) 的语音输入插件：输入框的麦克风按钮把语音转成草稿文本，支持多种语音识别后端，可选经 dsh 自有 LLM 路由润色，并带原生设置页。

description.en: Floating NetEase Cloud Music player for DSH Web: draggable collapsible window with mini mode, playlist discovery with search and hot lists, synced lyrics with…
description.zh: 网易云音乐浮窗播放器：可拖拽/折叠浮窗与迷你条，歌单发现（搜索/热门歌单），逐行同步歌词与翻译，播放队列持久化，扫码或 Cookie 登录，颜色跟随 DSH 皮肤主题。

description.en: Codex-style window capture for DSH Desktop on macOS and Windows: press both Command keys (macOS) or both Ctrl keys (Windows), or the camera button, to grab the…
description.zh: 给 DSH Desktop 用的窗口截图，支持 macOS 和 Windows：macOS 按两边 Command、Windows 按两边 Ctrl（或点输入框旁相机）捕获当前前台窗口并附加到会话，同时把 VoiceOver 风格的辅助功能树注入为隐藏上下文。

description.en: Arrow-key input history for DSH 0.1.2-alpha.1: press ↑ in an empty composer to recall this session's prompts, ↓ to go forward, Esc to restore the draft.
description.zh: DSH 0.1.2-alpha.1 输入框历史：空输入框按 ↑ 召回当前会话刚发过的话，↓ 前进，Esc 还原正在打的草稿。

description.en: Per-turn file-change card for DSH Desktop: +N −M badges, aligned diffs, and Mac/Windows file open (system app, Finder/Explorer, VS Code).
description.zh: 给 DSH Desktop 用的轮末改动卡：编辑/写入行显示 +N −M，点开审 diff；macOS 和 Windows 可用系统应用、文件夹或 VS Code 打开文件。

description.en: Specialized in Git branch and status handling: a Git status drawer on the right edge of the DSH web UI with a commit DAG lane graph, uncommitted changes and…
description.zh: 专精于 Git 分支与状态处理：Web 右缘 Git 状态浮窗，commit DAG 泳道图、未提交改动与 stash、行内 diff，右键分支/tag 切换、合并、重命名、删除、新建，一键拉取全部远程。

description.en: Shows the running agent step above the web composer as a Chinese sentence: its step number, the tools it is running, and how long it has been going. A finished…
description.zh: 在网页版输入框上方用一句中文显示当前正在执行的智能体步骤：步号、正在执行的工具、以及已运行多久。步骤结束后会保留该步用时，直到下一步开始，因此慢步骤事后也能查证。

description.en: Teaches Herdr about DSH panes: reports agent working/idle/blocked state — including the blocked state DSH itself lacks — enabling panel jump and --wait. (Herdr…

description.zh: 智能日程与待办助手：农历节气、macOS/Windows 原生桌面弹窗、企微多平台推送与拖拽改期。

description.en: NextTavern is a long-form roleplay plugin for DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7-rc.2 Web, with character-card import and creation, worldlines, worldbooks, layered…
description.zh: NextTavern 是面向 DeepSeek Harness 0.1.7-rc.2 Web 的长篇角色扮演插件，支持角色卡导入与创作、世界线、世界书、分层长期记忆、关键词／语义／混合检索、角色 Agent，以及角色卡或小说导出；支持 SillyTavern 角色卡导入，v0.2.9 修复分发与安装问题。

description.en: Merges other sessions' context into the current turn: evidence-weighted conflict resolution, retraction of claims whose premises were retracted, trust…
description.zh: 把其他会话的上下文合并进当前回合：按证据裁决冲突、前提被撤回时同步撤回结论、用信任格抵抗跨会话提示注入，并在 token 预算内打包。附带评测基准。

description.en: Unofficial Gemini Cloud Code Assist OAuth integration with isolated account storage; carries account-ban risk.
description.zh: 提供独立账户存储的非官方 Gemini Cloud Code Assist OAuth 接入，存在封号风险。

description.en: A calmer reading view for DeepSeek Harness: native process details, live reasoning, and clean final answers.
description.zh: 更安静的 DeepSeek Harness 阅读视图：原生过程细节、实时推理，以及干净的最终回答。

description.en: Uses a dedicated model for context compaction rescue and adds manual compaction to the native context popup.
description.zh: 使用专用模型处理上下文压缩恢复，并在原生上下文弹窗提供手动压缩。

description.en: Creates, activates, checks and removes external DSH plugins from a conversation through fixed tools; requires the external DSHX devkit.
description.zh: 通过对话中的固定工具创建、激活、检查和移除外部 DSH 插件，需要外部 DSHX 开发工具。

description.en: macOS computer-use tools backed by a plugin-owned Cua Driver runtime.
description.zh: 通过插件独立管理的 Cua Driver 运行时提供 macOS 电脑操作工具。

description.en: Adds drag-and-drop attachments for local files, folders, ZIP archives and Office documents.
description.zh: 支持拖放本地文件、文件夹、ZIP 压缩包和 Office 文档作为附件。

description.en: Adds a Firecrawl search provider with multi-account API-key settings.
description.zh: 提供 Firecrawl 搜索服务及多账户 API Key 设置。

description.en: Connects a DSH Host to Slack and Feishu using your own bot applications.
description.zh: 使用自建机器人应用，将一个 DSH Host 接入 Slack 和飞书。

description.en: Displays generated images in a conversation gallery with a lightbox viewer.
description.zh: 以对话内画廊和灯箱展示生成的图片。

description.en: Adds a model route where a Lead plans and reviews while a Sidekick performs code changes.
description.zh: 提供由 Lead 规划与审查、Sidekick 执行代码修改的组合模型线路。

description.en: Companion for DSH Notch that synchronizes session navigation and read state with DSH Desktop and Web.
description.zh: DSH Notch 的配套助手，同步 Desktop、Web 与 Notch 之间的会话跳转和已读状态。

description.en: Connects DSH session status, approvals and questions to a native macOS notch app; requires the native app and Focus companion.
description.zh: 将 DSH 会话状态、审批和问题同步到原生 macOS 刘海程序，需要原生程序及 Focus 同步助手。

description.en: Adds subscription OAuth and provider Plan API-key logins through Pi adapters, using a DSH-owned credential store.
description.zh: 通过 Pi 适配器接入订阅 OAuth 和厂商 Plan API Key 登录，使用独立的 DSH 凭据存储。

description.en: Browses and manages user skills already on disk in DSH and supported agent home directories.
description.zh: 浏览和管理 DSH 及受支持 Agent 主目录中已有的用户技能。

description.en: Read-only session work-path observer: fold turns into stage, run, duration and tok/s summaries, then expand parallel branches, tool results and vendor-visible…
description.zh: 只读会话工作路径观察器：收起轮次看阶段数、执行数、耗时与 tok/s，展开看并行分支、工具结果与供应商可见推理。

description.en: Ports poteto's pstack engineering playbooks to DSH, covering planning, review, verification and release workflows.
description.zh: 将 poteto 的 pstack 工程工作流移植到 DSH，涵盖规划、审查、验证与发布。

description.en: Shows which graft index a dsh session is serving and whether it still matches the code, and gives the model graft_ask, graft_grep, graft_callers,…
description.zh: 显示当前 dsh 会话所用的 graft 索引、以及它是否仍与代码一致，并把 graft_ask、graft_grep、graft_callers、graft_skeleton、graft_map 作为原生工具交给模型。

description.en: Persistent memory for dsh in the style of Hermes Agent: a memory tool that keeps a user profile and the model's own notes, delivered to every chat as a logged…
description.zh: Hermes Agent 风格的 dsh 持久记忆：一个 memory 工具维护用户档案与模型自己的笔记，并在每段对话的开头、记忆变更后、压缩之后各投递一条带记录的消息；session_search 工具只在用户同意后才会读取更早的会话；另有 Memory 面板可查看和编辑已保存的内容。

description.en: Schedule a message into a dsh chat for later: a Schedule button in the message box with a date and time picker, a sidebar panel of pending messages across…
description.zh: 把消息排进 dsh 会话稍后再发：消息框里带日期与时间选择器的「定时」按钮、跨会话列出待发消息的侧栏面板、浏览器关着也由宿主按时投递成一条普通用户消息，以及 schedule_message / list_scheduled_messages / cancel_scheduled_message…

description.en: Persistent tmux control-mode cockpit for DSH Web that mirrors native panes in a dock.
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 提供持久的 tmux 控制模式驾驶舱，在停靠栏中镜像原生窗格。

description.en: Distills daily AI conversations (Doubao, ChatGPT, DeepSeek, Kimi) into structured Markdown notes in your Obsidian vault.
description.zh: 把每天和各种 AI 的对话提炼成结构化 Markdown 笔记，写入你的 Obsidian 库。

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to the AdWhispr remote MCP server through mcp-remote with browser OAuth sign-in, adding tools for competitor ad research, ad creative…
description.zh: 通过 mcp-remote 加浏览器 OAuth 登录，把 DeepSeek Harness 接到 AdWhispr 的远程 MCP 服务：竞品广告调研、广告创意克隆，以及 Meta／Google／TikTok 广告的投放与管理。需要 AdWhispr 账号。

description.en: Real DeepSeek account balance and official spend tracker in the session header, with peak/off-peak badge, monetary alert with auto-stop, and one-click top-up.
description.zh: 会话头部的真实 DeepSeek 余额与官方消费统计：高峰/空闲标签、按金额提醒与自动停止、一键充值。

description.en: Conversation minimap docked on the right edge of the dsh Web chat: colour-block and to-scale thumbnail modes, drag-to-resize (10–320px), hover loupe preview,…
description.zh: 停靠在 dsh Web 对话区右缘的会话代码地图：色块/缩略图双模式、拖动调宽（10–320px）、悬停放大镜预览、点击跳转与拖动滚动（带实时视口指示条）、可收起为 4px 细条。

description.en: Gives an agent its own email inbox through AgentMail — eleven tools for sending, reading and labelling mail, plus inbound mail delivered into one harness…
description.zh: 用 AgentMail 给 agent 配一个自己的收件箱：发信、读信、搜索与打标签共十一个工具；收到的邮件按邮件线程分派，每个线程对应一个独立会话；所有外发邮件都要过审批与收件人白名单。

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to ReMe's local-first, self-evolving personal knowledge base: automatically captures completed main-agent conversations as user-owned…
description.zh: 将 DeepSeek Harness 接入 ReMe 本地优先、自进化的个人知识库：自动把已完成的主 Agent 对话沉淀为用户掌控的 Markdown 记忆，通过 reme_search 结合 BM25、可选向量检索和 wikilink 展开搜索对话与资料，并按日整理长期记忆。

description.en: Runs /single-turn and /multi-turn answers in isolated sub-agents so results stay in the current chat and never enter the main model context.
description.zh: 用 /single-turn 与 /multi-turn 在独立子代理中作答，结果只留在当前对话，不进入主模型上下文。

description.en: Password-gated public access for the DSH Web GUI through quick or named Cloudflare Tunnels, with HTTP/WebSocket proxying and an in-app directory picker.
description.zh: 通过快速或命名 Cloudflare Tunnel 为 DSH Web GUI 提供密码保护的公网访问，并代理 HTTP/WebSocket 流量、改用应用内目录选择器。

description.en: Dockable DSH Web UI layout that organizes conversations as tabs across draggable split groups.
description.zh: 可停靠的 DSH Web UI 布局插件，将对话组织为标签页，并支持拖拽拆分对话分组。

description.en: Patent-writing gatekeeper for dsh - screens the idea against Chinese prior art first, then runs five-party alignment interviews, eight-chapter disclosure…
description.zh: dsh 专利撰写把关人：动笔前先检索中国专利给出三档结论，再走五方对齐访谈、八章交底书、附图与仿真实验、七维审查与 docx/PDF 导出全流程。技能开箱即用；检索、导出与实验工具来自内置的 Python MCP 服务，默认关闭——在 ~/.dsh/patent-services.yaml 里开一行即启用，uvx…

description.en: Turns a learning request and local materials into a structured, locally stored AI course with outline, lessons, diagrams and learning progress.
description.zh: 把学习诉求和手头资料变成结构化、纯本地的 AI 课程，含大纲、知识点内容、图表与学习进度。

description.en: Evidence-bound negative-knowledge ledger: persists disproven paths (command_failed, file_missing) with their outcome and precondition evidence, then warns or…
description.zh: 证据约束的负面知识账本：记录被证伪的路径（command_failed / file_missing）及其结果与前置条件证据，重复尝试时警告或拦截，证据变化后自动解除。

description.en: Neutralize tool calls with invalid JSON arguments on the wire so one malformed model generation cannot brick a session against strict OpenAI-compatible servers.
description.zh: 在 wire 层中性化 arguments 为非法 JSON 的 tool call，避免一次模型畸形输出让 session 在严格 OpenAI 兼容服务端上永久 400。

description.en: Real Madrid dual-mode skin: Bernabeu night stadium for dark, white-kit pinstripes with crest and 1902 layers for light. Unofficial fan work.
description.zh: 皇家马德里双模式皮肤：暗色为夜场伯纳乌全景，亮色为纯白主场暗纹，队徽与 1902 背号作为背景层（非官方球迷作品）。

description.en: Read, edit, export and verify Excel VBA projects through a real Excel COM instance: modules, UserForm code, procedure lists and .frm/.frx exports. Windows…
description.zh: 通过真实 Excel COM 读写、导出并校验 Excel VBA 工程：模块、窗体代码、过程清单与 .frm/.frx 导出。仅 Windows：需安装桌面版 Excel、Python 3.10+（含 pywin32），并设置 AccessVBOM=1。

description.en: Phone-side command center rather than a web-UI mirror: dispatch tasks into isolated git worktrees from a PWA, tool-approval push notifications with…
description.zh: 面向手机的指挥台而非 Web UI 镜像：从 PWA 把任务派发进隔离的 git worktree，工具审批推送通知支持手机/桌面「谁先答谁算」（绝不自动批准），多机会话看板，以及可自建的端到端加密零知识中继。

description.en: One-stop visual management of DSH Skills & MCP: on-demand MCP loading, in-session hot reload, SKILL & MCP descriptions viewable in the plugin.
description.zh: 一站式可视化管理 DSH 的 SKILL 与 MCP：MCP按需加载、会话内热重载、SKILL与MCP描述可在插件内直接查看

description.en: Runs one-time and RFC 5545 recurring Agent tasks in fresh DSH sessions, with visual schedule editing and session-linked history.
description.zh: 在全新的 DSH 会话中运行单次或 RFC 5545 周期 Agent 任务，支持可视化计划编辑和会话关联历史。

description.en: A shared kanban board that lets people and DSH agents manage workspace tasks through a Board tab and kanban tools.
description.zh: 一个由用户与 DSH Agent 共同维护的工作区看板，通过看板标签页和 kanban 工具管理任务。

description.en: A minimal worktree management solution with only one button and one dialog.
description.zh: 极简 worktree 管理方案，只有一个按钮和一个弹窗。

description.en: Conversation navigation with full-history turns, collapsible process steps, final-result and structured question-and-answer keys, and pointer-following piano…
description.zh: 提供完整历史轮次导航、过程步骤折叠、最终结果与结构化问答琴键，以及鼠标连续跟随交互。

description.en: Google Antigravity (agy CLI) models for DSH — streaming chat with Gemini/Claude/GPT-OSS subscriptions, native tool cards, thinking turns, and in-GUI Google…
description.zh: 将 Google Antigravity (agy CLI) 接入 DSH：无 API Key 使用 Gemini/Claude/GPT-OSS 订阅模型，支持流式对话、原生工具卡片、思考轮次注记及 Web 界面 Google OAuth 扫码登录。

description.en: High-reliability Feishu/Lark bridge for DeepSeek Harness: QR one-click auth, card-based commands and intent-confirmation cards, at-least-once zero-loss outbox,…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的高可靠飞书/Lark 桥接：扫码一键认证、卡片化命令与意图确认、at-least-once 零丢失出站队列、多媒体出入站、/doctor 会话日志 ZIP，并复用 DSH Web GUI 把会话归入正确工作区。

description.en: Desktop tweaks: F11 fullscreen toggle; enables Ctrl+C / Ctrl+V copy and paste in the terminal, both switchable in the General settings.
description.zh: 桌面修改：F11 全屏切换；使终端使用 Ctrl+C/V 复制粘贴，从通用设置内开启/关闭。

description.en: Provider-aware account balance chip for the DSH sidebar, showing the active model provider balance for DeepSeek, OpenRouter, Moonshot/Kimi, Zhipu/GLM, and…
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏的账户余额胶囊，跟随当前模型的服务商显示余额，支持 DeepSeek、OpenRouter、Moonshot/Kimi、Zhipu/GLM 与 MiniMax，并显示 DeepSeek 高峰/空闲时段。

description.en: macOS desk pet that lives outside the DSH page: a real always-on-top window that clears fullscreen Spaces, six states driven by local DSH, a native right-click…
description.zh: 装在 DSH 页面之外的 macOS 桌宠：一个真的置顶窗口，全屏 Space 也盖得住；六种状态跟着本地 DSH 走，原生右键菜单里有免打扰与会话清单；自带的 skill 用你自己的画图工具和额度，把一张照片变成整套十八个姿势的皮肤。跑系统自带的 Python 与 ctypes，不用 Electron，零依赖。

description.en: Adds COS storage browsing and transfers, workspace artifact uploads, temporary links, and conversation attachments that retain local copies with cloud object…
description.zh: 提供 COS 云存储浏览与传输、工作区产物上传、临时链接，以及同时保留本地副本和云端对象身份的会话附件，并提供腾讯云 COS、数据万象和 MetaInsight 的 Agent 工具。

description.en: Hierarchical Claude Code-style memory: user + project scopes (project memories committed to git for the team), MEMORY.md index auto-injected at session start,…
description.zh: 分层 Claude Code 式记忆：用户级+项目级双作用域（项目记忆随 git 团队共享），MEMORY.md 索引会话启动自动注入，上下文护栏，纯文件零依赖。

description.en: Replaces the stock bash/pwsh terminal rows in the DSH web UI with shell command cards: long commands soft-wrap with line numbers instead of truncating, plus…
description.zh: 用自定义 Shell 命令卡片替换 DSH Web 原版 bash/pwsh 工具行：长命令自动换行带行号不再截断，并提供独立的复制命令/复制输出按钮。

description.en: Self-contained browser runtime: Playwright (chromium) + OpenCLI as plugin-local dependencies (global reuse fallback), exposes a `browser` service and 9…
description.zh: 自包含浏览器运行时：Playwright（chromium）+ OpenCLI 作为插件本地依赖（全局复用回退），提供 `browser` 服务与 9 个交互式浏览器工具。

description.en: Inspect and simulate DSH context consumption with trajectory and inventory views, and create, inject, import, or safely repair session messages through the…
description.zh: 上下文控制台：通过轨迹墙与库存视图检查并模拟 DSH 上下文消费，并由内置消息锻造台创建、注入、导入或安全修复会话消息。

description.en: Restart DSH: configurable restart method (Node native / legacy PowerShell), post-restart continue prompt, optional watchdog auto-relaunch.
description.zh: DSH 重启插件：可配置的重启方式（Node 原生/旧 PowerShell 适配）、重启后自动继续的提示词、可选看门狗自动拉起。

description.en: Diagnose duplicate DSH loader entry IDs before startup, report version-locked repair status in a read-only settings card, and apply or revert audited loader…
description.zh: 在 DSH 启动前诊断重复的 loader entry ID，通过只读设置卡片报告版本锁定的修复状态，并使用外部 CLI 应用或撤销经过审计的 loader 修复。

description.en: Browser Web Speech API voice input: zero server, zero keys, zero model downloads (Edge=Azure, Chrome=Google speech).
description.zh: 浏览器 Web Speech API 语音输入：零服务端、零密钥、零模型下载（Edge=Azure 语音、Chrome=Google 语音）。

description.en: Persistent enhanced web search: multi-engine routing (DeepSeek/Exa/DDG/Bing/Jina + GitHub/Bilibili/YouTube/V2EX/Xiaohongshu/Twitter/Reddit/RSS), SQLite+LRU…
description.zh: 增强型、可持久化的网页搜索：多引擎路由（DeepSeek/Exa/DDG/Bing/Jina + GitHub/B站/YouTube/V2EX/小红书/Twitter/Reddit/RSS）、SQLite+LRU 缓存、userscript 风格抽取、Playwright 渲染。

description.en: AnySearch-powered real-time web and vertical search provider for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 基于 AnySearch 的实时网页与垂直搜索插件，为 DeepSeek Harness 提供搜索工具。

description.en: Brings the models included in the Xiaomi MiMo desktop app (free during beta) into DeepSeek Harness, with zero configuration in the DSH conversation window.
description.zh: 将 mimo桌面端包含的模型（内测有免费额度）自动接入 DeepSeek Harness，在 DSH 对话窗口里零配置使用。

description.en: Drag-and-drop file attachments as Codex-style cards, with in-app PDF/text/video/audio previews and system-default opening for other formats.
description.zh: 拖拽文件以 Codex 风格附件卡片呈现，支持 PDF/文本/音视频应用内预览，其余格式调用系统默认应用打开。

description.en: Multi-tab side chat for DeepSeek Harness. Quote a whole message or text selected from a still-streaming reply into a side chat without waiting for the reply to…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 多标签侧聊增强：可引用整条消息，也可在回复生成中选中文本追问（无需等待回复完成）；右侧停靠面板随 better-sidebar 开关在覆盖与让位间自动切换。

description.en: Boot-time guard that repairs corrupt session logs, preflights plugin composition, vm-checks client artifacts, smoke-tests host apply() and quarantines…
description.zh: 启动守卫：修复会话日志、预检插件组合、校验客户端工件、冒烟宿主 apply() 并隔离崩溃源，让坏插件再也无法砖掉启动。

description.en: Declarative task-DAG orchestration for DSH: validates dependency graphs, runs topological task layers in parallel through workflow-backed subagents, and…
description.zh: DSH 声明式任务 DAG 编排：校验依赖图，通过工作流子智能体并行执行拓扑任务层，并确定性传播失败。

description.en: MCP management page in DSH Settings: list, enable/disable, restart and delete MCP servers, edit them in form or JSON mode, expand a server to see the tools it…
description.zh: DSH 设置中的 MCP 管理页：列出、启停、重启、删除 MCP 服务器，表单与 JSON 双模式编辑，展开可查看各服务器注册的工具，并支持一次粘贴导入 Claude Code、Cursor、Codex、VS Code 等 14 种工具的 MCP 配置。

description.en: Pinned-version REA for DeepSeek Harness: installs rea-agents locally, starts its MCP server from that pinned copy, and upgrades only when you press Update.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 固定版本的 REA：把 rea-agents 安装到当前配置档的一个确切版本，从该副本启动其 MCP 服务，只有按下「更新」才升级。

description.en: Manage DSH skills and commands from Settings: list, enable/disable, edit, delete and add skills across global and project scopes, and save reusable prompts as…
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置中管理技能与命令：跨全局与项目作用域查看、启用/停用、编辑、删除与添加技能，并把常用提示词保存为斜杠命令。

description.en: Layered file memory for DeepSeek Harness with workspace-scoped USER/MEMORY notes, background consolidation, and hybrid session recall.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 分层文件记忆，提供工作区隔离的 USER/MEMORY 笔记、后台沉淀与混合会话召回。

description.en: Makes the WorkBuddy desktop app's web search the dsh web_search provider, reusing the app's existing sign-in with no extra configuration.
description.zh: 把 WorkBuddy 桌面 App 的网络搜索作为 dsh 的 web_search 提供方，复用 App 已有的登录状态，无需额外配置。

description.en: An unofficial Arknights P.R.T.S.-inspired interface theme for DSH Web with appearance presets, accessibility controls, and conversation navigation.
description.zh: 面向 DSH Web 的非官方明日方舟 P.R.T.S. 风格界面主题，提供外观预设、辅助功能与会话导航。

description.en: Select a term in a DeepSeek Harness conversation and press the Search button beside it to read the explanation in place: basic meaning, purpose and usage, with…
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话里选中一个术语、点旁边的「搜索」按钮，就地解释基本含义、用途与用法，并显示这次回答消耗的 token；该调用是旁路调用，不写入会话日志。

description.en: Quick-open palette for the Web GUI: Ctrl+P fuzzy-searches an in-memory index of the session workspace (about 51k entries, median query 5 ms) with per-segment…
description.zh: Web GUI 的快速打开面板：Ctrl+P 在会话工作区的内存索引上做模糊检索（约 5.1 万条目，查询中位数 5 ms），支持逐段路径锚定、dir: 与 file: 前缀、Tab 目录下钻与 :行号 跳转；选中文件走 DSH 原生右栏打开，Ctrl+Enter 把文件引用放进会话草稿。另为内置文件预览补上文件内查找…

description.en: Find plugins without leaving the agent: search this curated registry by keyword or category, with ready-to-run install commands.
description.zh: 会话内直接找插件：按关键词/分类搜索本精选 registry，返回描述与可直接执行的安装命令。

description.en: Restores the blue shimmering Deep diving turn status row that DSH 0.1.6 and earlier showed at the end of the transcript.
description.zh: 恢复 DSH 0.1.6 及以前在对话流末尾显示的蓝色流光深度求索中回合状态行.

description.en: Adds a UI effects page to Settings that switches off DSH Web animations and transitions, loading and progress animations, backdrop blur, smooth scrolling,…
description.zh: 在设置里新增 "前端特效" 页, 按分类关掉 DSH Web 的动画与过渡, 加载与进度动画, 毛玻璃, 平滑滚动, 标题 hover 滚动, 阴影, 渐变与 JS 动效, 降低浏览器渲染负担.

description.en: Keep declared workspace subpaths (e.g. .git) read-only, honor a read-only rules file at the workspace root, grant extra writable roots under workspace-write,…
description.zh: 为 DSH 沙箱增加工作区子路径只读保护 (例如 .git), 支持工作区根下的只读规则文件, 可在 workspace-write 下声明额外可写根, 并允许模型申请本会话的可写授权; 命令沙箱与 write/edit 工具都生效.

description.en: Edit the global ~/.dsh/AGENTS.md rules from the web settings panel, live on save.
description.zh: 在设置面板中编辑 ~/.dsh/AGENTS.md 全局规则，保存后实时生效。

description.en: Leafy green skin for the DSH Web GUI that overrides the --dsw-* palette in light and dark themes, plus a CSS layer for corners, shadows and motion that can be…
description.zh: 叶绿色皮肤：把 DSH Web GUI 的 --dsw-* 调色板覆盖成浅色 / 深色两套叶绿配色，另有一层可关闭的样式层处理圆角、阴影与动效。

description.en: Shows OpenCode Go quota usage in the web sidebar's bottom-left corner — rolling/weekly/monthly progress with a hover card, plus a Beijing-time DeepSeek…
description.zh: 在 Web 侧边栏左下角显示 OpenCode Go 用量——滚动/本周/本月配额进度与悬停明细卡片，并附按北京时间标记的 DeepSeek 高峰时段进度条。

description.en: Render GeoJSON or vector data into an interactive GeoLibre map in a sidebar tab, and let agents operate the live map through tools: layers, styles, view,…
description.zh: 把 GeoJSON / 矢量数据渲染成侧边栏「地图」tab 里的交互地图，并让 Agent 通过工具实时操作地图：图层、样式、视图、要素识别、GeoLibre 处理算法与 Whitebox 工具箱（浏览器端 WASM 执行）。

description.en: Ranks workspaces holding a session that wants attention to the top of the sidebar session list - waiting on you first, then running, then…
description.zh: 把含“需要注意的会话”的工作区按紧急度排到侧栏会话列表最前——待你处理优先，其次运行中，再次完成未读，最后刚读过的——并为这些行画状态竖条、着色底与着色标题，一次运行结束时播放一次收敛动效。所有颜色都取自当前主题自身的变量；决定完成会话置顶时长的三个窗口都是可配置项。

description.en: Let a local DeepSeek Harness Agent use BailingHub to query data, update records, and run permitted actions in an online store, SaaS, or other admin system.
description.zh: 让本地 DeepSeek Harness 智能体通过 BailingHub，直接操作商城、SaaS 或其他业务系统后台，在现有账号权限内查询数据、修改资料并执行已开放的操作。

description.en: On Windows, the available bash tool is limited to Git Bash and PowerShell is disabled.
description.zh: 让 Windows 上可用的 bash 工具限制为 Git Bash,并禁用 PowerShell。

description.en: Codex-shaped coding tools and agent presets for GPT models on DeepSeek Harness: exec_command, write_stdin, apply_patch and view_image, plus OpenAI Chat…
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 上 GPT 模型的 Codex 风格编码工具与 agent 预设：exec_command、write_stdin、apply_patch、view_image，以及 OpenAI Chat Completions 与 Responses API 两条路由，并桥接 DSH…

description.en: Pools several OpenCode Go API keys and hot-switches each request to the least-used one, with official usage and balance lookup plus a graphical settings page.
description.zh: 聚合多个 OpenCode Go API key，把每次请求热切换到用量最低的一个，并提供官方用量/余额查询与设置页图形化管理。

description.en: After official llm-retry (n/5) gives up, keep retrying transient API failures (timeout, transport, rate-limit, 5xx, dropped SSE) on the same open step until…
description.zh: 官方 llm-retry（n/5）耗尽后，对超时/传输/限流/5xx/SSE 断流等瞬时失败在同一打开 step 上继续重试直到成功、取消或暂停；认证失败、额度耗尽和用户停止不会重试。

description.en: Two-step inline archive on workspace sidebar rows — one click arms a red confirm, the second click archives; the archive entry is removed from the ⋮ menu.
description.zh: 工作区侧边栏行内两击归档：点一次变红确认，再点即归档，归档项不再出现在 ⋮ 菜单里。

description.en: Local cross-session messaging for DSH agents, with discovery, cold-session wake-up delivery, and auditable message history.
description.zh: 面向 DSH Agent 的本地跨会话消息桥：支持会话发现、冷会话唤醒投递与可审计消息记录。

description.en: Group chat rooms for DSH sessions with explicit @mentions, cold-session wake-up delivery, and optional cross-host transport through dsh-weave.
description.zh: 面向 DSH 会话的群聊室：支持明确 @ 提及、冷会话唤醒投递，并可通过 dsh-weave 跨主机通信。

description.en: Authenticated LAN, Tailnet, and public HTTPS access for a DSH Host, with persistent host identity, pairing, and QR setup.
description.zh: 为 DSH Host 提供经认证的局域网、Tailnet 与公网 HTTPS 接入，支持持久主机身份、配对和二维码配置。

description.en: Trusted Iroh mesh networking for DSH hosts, with encrypted peer discovery, remote session delivery, and reachability status.
description.zh: 基于 Iroh 的可信 DSH 主机网状网络：提供加密的节点发现、远程会话投递与连通状态。

description.en: Kids' coding classroom: run Python and LOGO-turtle code, explain, practice, review and step through programs.
description.zh: 小朋友的编程小教室：跑 Python 与海龟画图代码、讲解、练习、点评、分步。

description.en: Explains computer memory as a workbench: current usage, memory pressure and top programs.
description.zh: 把内存讲成工作台：当前占用、内存压力、最占内存的程序。

description.en: Network explorer for kids: my identity, DNS lookup, a traceroute trip, speed test and who is home on the LAN.
description.zh: 网络小旅行：我的身份、DNS 查询、路由追踪、测速、谁在局域网。

description.en: Processes as little workers: how many, the busiest, the family tree and badges.
description.zh: 进程小工人：数量、谁最卖力、家族树、工牌。

description.en: Computer safety shown as castle guards: firewall, disk encryption, lock screen, remote ports and login history.
description.zh: 电脑安全小城堡守卫：防火墙、磁盘加密、锁屏、远程端口、登录记录。

description.en: Storage explorer: disk boxes, the home folder and the heaviest items.
description.zh: 存储小仓库：磁盘分区、主目录、最占空间的东西。

description.en: System monitor for kids: a single card summary of CPU, memory and disk.
description.zh: 系统小监控：一张卡片看 CPU、内存、磁盘概况。

description.en: Construction cost workbench for DeepSeek Harness projects.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 项目的工程造价工作台。

description.en: DSH sidebar file-activity tab: records file reads/creates/modifies by the agent and the sidebar (including file ops hidden inside bash commands), per-session…
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏文件活动页签：记录 agent 与侧边栏的文件读取/新增/修改事件（含 bash 命令中隐含的文件操作），按会话隔离、重启后恢复，点击文件浮窗预览（npm: `dsh-file-activity`）。

description.en: Conversation rendering: every fenced block is rendered by the plugin itself (markdown for text fences, language-banner code blocks with highlight.js for…
description.zh: 对话渲染：围栏块由插件自身渲染（text 家族按 markdown，其余为真实语言名 banner + highlight.js 高亮的代码块），mermaid 块渲染为可缩放图表卡片，另支持上下文注入块渲染、整段复制与 MarkdownView 导出（npm: `dsh-md-render`）。

description.en: Context lens: visualizes token usage of every request (context composition, KV cache hit rate) and enforces per-turn / per-session budgets with warning and…
description.zh: 上下文透镜：可视化每次请求的 token 用量（上下文构成、KV 缓存命中率），并提供每轮 / 每会话预算控制（超限提醒与拦截）（npm: `dsh-my-context`）。

description.en: Plugin governance: new/updated plugins stage in a candidate area first, then hot-mount after startup — success promotes, failure auto-disables, repeated…
description.zh: 插件治理：新装/更新插件先进候选区，启动完成后热挂载——成功自动转正，失败自动禁用，连续失败冻结，一键安全模式，侧边栏诊断面板（npm: `dsh-my-guardian`）。

description.en: Memory in global and per-project scopes: memories are injected into the system prompt at session start, a settings panel edits them with confirmation on write,…
description.zh: 全局 / 项目两级记忆：会话开始时把记忆注入系统提示词，设置页面板支持新增 / 修改 / 删除（写操作需确认），并为 agent 提供只读查询工具 memory_query（npm: `dsh-my-memory`）。

description.en: Browser notifications and a beep when a session turn ends, the agent asks a question or approval is pending; clicking the notification jumps to the session;…
description.zh: 会话（本轮）结束 / agent 询问 / 等待审批时弹浏览器通知 + 滴声，点击通知跳转会话；预留远程触发接口与 SSE 实时通道（npm: `dsh-my-notify`）。

description.en: Observability and git tooling: a persistent cross-session event audit log with a query API, a resource watchdog sidebar panel, structured Conventional Commits…
description.zh: 可观测性与 Git 工程工具：跨会话持久化的事件审计日志与查询 API、资源看门狗侧边栏面板、结构化 Conventional Commits 提交、提交前增量 diff 审查（npm: `dsh-my-observability`）。

description.en: Injects a per-session x-opencode-session header into opencode.ai inference requests, fixing the OpenCode Go gateway 400 MissingSessionID error; server-only, no…
description.zh: 为 opencode.ai 的推理请求注入按会话稳定的 x-opencode-session 头，修复 OpenCode Go 网关 400 MissingSessionID；纯 server 插件，无界面（npm: `dsh-my-opencode-session-header`）。

description.en: Remote control: pushes ask / approval / session-end events to an external channel webhook and lets you answer, approve, query status or continue a session from…
description.zh: 远程控制：把 ask / 审批 / 会话结束事件推送到外部通道 webhook，可用 token 鉴权在手机上回答问题、批准请求、查询状态或继续会话（npm: `dsh-my-remote`）。

description.en: Skill management: lists skills in global and per-project scopes and toggles each one per project; a disabled skill is not injected into that session (npm:…
description.zh: Skill 管理：按全局 / 项目两个范围查看 skill 列表，并按项目启用或禁用；被禁用的 skill 不会注入该会话（npm: `dsh-my-skill-manager`）。

description.en: Task reliability: auto-retry on model timeouts/failures, auto-continue unfinished tasks, completion verification, thinking-repeat interruption, resume after…
description.zh: 任务可靠性：模型超时/请求失败自动重试、任务未完成自动继续、独立完成度校验、思考重复检测打断、休眠/重启后任务自动恢复、自主决策模式、远程触发接口（npm: `dsh-task-reliability`）。

description.en: Runs TiddlyWiki 5 as the DSH persistent knowledge base: ten tiddlywiki_* agent tools (filtered search, read/write/batch/rename/delete, recent, tags, git sync…
description.zh: 把 TiddlyWiki 5 变成 DSH 的持久知识库：十个 tiddlywiki_* 智能体工具（带过滤的检索、读写/批量/改名/删除、最近、标签，以及 git 同步与冲突解决），GUI 中央栏经同源代理内嵌完整 TiddlyWiki 编辑器，右侧栏知识库 Tab，会话级汇总本会话读写过的笔记，快速笔记卡片支持草稿…

description.en: Mobile web shell for the DSH Web GUI: overlay drawers, draggable FAB, mobile composer fixes, and a floating image-upload button pinned above the composer…
description.zh: DSH Web 界面的移动端外壳：抽屉式侧栏、可拖拽悬浮按钮、移动端输入框修复，以及悬浮在输入框上方的图片上传按钮（原生相册/拍照，走加图校验管线），桌面端零影响。已发布到 npm（dsh-webui-mobile）。

description.en: Holds the OS wake lock while any agent, subagent, or background job runs, releases it after a configurable grace period, and provides a bilingual web settings…
description.zh: 任意 agent、subagent 或后台任务运行时持有系统唤醒锁，全部结束后按可配置宽限期释放；提供中英双语 Web 设置页，实时显示活动与唤醒锁状态，支持手动保持与阻止屏幕关闭。

description.en: A usage and reference-cost panel for DeepSeek Harness with today, 7-day, 30-day, all-time and custom ranges aggregated by hour or day; a model filter and a…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的用量与参考成本面板，含今日 / 近 7 天 / 近 30 天 / 全部 / 自定义范围并按小时或天聚合；模型筛选与按模型明细（请求数、输入/输出 Token、缓存、参考成本、占比）；按总 Token 显示前 4 个模型、其余归入「其它」的模型占比卡；可配置的每百万 Token…
把 DSH 输入框里的一句话补成完整任务书（角色/目标/约束/输出格式）。引擎是 linshenkx/prompt-optimizer 的逐字节移植：三种优化模式、10 个模板与上游一致；历史为授权制、带版本链与结构对比；每次润色的 token 消耗可见。未经点击不写回、不发送。
description.en: Turns a one-line DSH draft into a complete task brief (role / goal / constraints / output format). The engine is a byte-verified port of linshenkx/prompt-optimi…
Per-call cache billing inside the context-meter popover: current step, round and session totals with hit/miss/output tokens and amounts, automatic Beijing…
description.zh: 在上下文圆环弹层里实时算账：当前步、当前轮、会话累计三块明细，缓存命中/未命中/输出各带 token 与金额，官方峰谷价与模型分价自动判定，第三方中转照常记账。

description.en: Slides out a Monaco editor plus a lazy-loaded file-tree panel in the DSH Web conversation, so you can edit the local workspace inline without switching to an…
description.zh: 在 DSH 对话界面右侧滑出 Monaco 编辑器与文件树面板，直接在对话里编辑本地工作区代码，无需切到外部编辑器。

description.en: Client-side re-render of edit/write tool cards with a near-linear line-level diff that drops duplicate unchanged lines and underlines the actual changed…
description.zh: 接管浏览器端 edit/write 工具卡片，用近线性行级 diff 只显示真正变化行，并对替换对做行内字符下划线高亮，消除内置 diff 对未变化相同行的重复渲染。

description.en: Live token stats under the DSH Web composer: streamed tokens/s, output token and first-byte latency, plus per-step estimate-vs-actual reconciliation using the…
description.zh: 在输入框下方实时渲染 token 状态带：基于 DeepSeek 官方 BPE 分词表显示流式 token/s、输出 token 与首字延迟，并对比每次 step 的估算与实际偏差，用于判断生成是慢还是卡住。

description.en: Below 1024px the sidebar collapses to a 44px floating square and expands into a 280px overlay drawer; picking a session collapses it again and the focus grab…
description.zh: 窄屏下侧栏收起为左上角 44 像素悬浮方块、展开为 280 像素覆盖式抽屉，点会话自动收起，并压掉切会话时自动抢焦点导致的软键盘顶起。

description.en: Browser system notification, sounded by the OS notification itself, when a session needs a reply or a run goes idle; no page-focus check, at most one…
description.zh: 会话出现待回复交互或一轮跑完落到空闲时弹出浏览器系统通知，提示音由系统通知自带；不判断页面是否聚焦，每个会话最多保留一条通知、新通知顶掉旧的，空闲时若还有后台任务会在正文里说明数量。

description.en: Pauses the agent right before it sends the next model request of a tool round while keeping the composer usable: a bare Enter or the resume button lets it…
description.zh: 在模型完成一轮工具交互、正要发出下一次请求之前暂停，输入框保持可用：裸回车或点按钮放行，草稿有字则随本次请求一并发出作为插话；不打断任何在途 API 调用，模型上下文完整、察觉不到暂停。

description.en: During Beijing working-day peak hours (default 09:00-12:00 and 14:00-18:00) it blocks official DeepSeek requests or reroutes them to a configured target…
description.zh: 北京时间工作日高峰时段拦截发往官方 provider 的请求，默认 09:00-12:00、14:00-18:00，可切到配置的中转目标或直接阻止并提示，非高峰正常走官方。

description.en: Model-visible SSH file tools read_remote, write_remote and edit_remote: read a remote UTF-8 file with line-numbered paging, create a new remote file (an…
description.zh: 模型可直接调用的 ssh 远程文件三件套：read_remote 按行号分页读远端 UTF-8 文本，write_remote 只新建文件、目标已存在即拒绝且没有覆写分支，edit_remote 做唯一匹配的字面替换，三者共用取自 ~/.ssh/config 的「别名:路径」一个 file_path 字段。

description.en: Auto-expands newly arrived tool-call cards in the DSH Web UI, with a sidebar toggle cycling no-op/expand/collapse and the state persisted to localStorage.
description.zh: 自动展开 DSH 界面里新到达的工具调用卡片，侧栏开关在不干预/展开/折叠三态间循环，档位持久化到 localStorage。

description.en: Host-side guard that lets the write tool only create new files: when the target already exists it denies the call before execution and tells the model to use…
description.zh: 纯 host 端守卫，让 write 工具只允许创建新文件：目标已存在时在执行前直接拒绝并提示改用 edit，全局所有会话生效。

description.en: Blocks edit/write writes that contain characters matching configurable regex rules, executed before the tool runs, with configurable messages and same-turn…
description.zh: 在工具执行前拦截 edit/write 写入内容里匹配配置正则的字符，默认匹配全角圆括号，同一回合命中后连带拦截后续 pwsh，报错文案与正则均可配置。

description.en: Browser tab status indicator for dsh web: paints the document favicon from the session list (blue spinning while work runs, amber while waiting on the user,…
description.zh: 为 dsh web 绘制浏览器页签状态指示：根据会话列表把 favicon 画成状态圆环（执行中蓝色旋转、等待用户琥珀色、完成绿色）。

description.en: Bridge Claude Code's .claude/ directories into DSH with zero migration: project and user-level skills, commands, rules (one system-reminder envelope), agent…
description.zh: 把 Claude Code 的 .claude/ 目录零迁移桥接进 DSH：项目与用户级 skills、 斜杠命令、rules（单条 system-reminder 信封注入）、agent 文件、hooks （PreToolUse/PostToolUse/UserPromptSubmit/SessionStart/Se…

description.en: Adds mark-unread, copy session info, reveal in Finder or open with your IDE, and permanent delete (with child sessions) to the DSH sidebar session menu, plus…
description.zh: 给 DSH 侧边栏的会话右键菜单补上标记未读、复制会话信息、在访达中显示或换 IDE 打开、永久删除（连子会话一起删），并给会话行加上报错与未读状态点、悬浮卡信息、归档行的一键删除，以及一个可逐项开关菜单的设置面板；界面提供中英文两套文案。

description.en: Static and runtime security guard for dsh: rule-based scans for malicious code, prompt injection and token waste, runtime interception of dangerous tool calls,…

description.en: Codex-style left-gutter tick rail for each user turn, with hover preview and click-to-scroll.
description.zh: 对话区左侧 Codex 风格短横线锚点，悬停预览，点击跳转到对应轮次。

description.en: Extensible AI-driven group-reaction narrative game framework for DeepSeek Harness: type one action and multiple NPCs each respond in their own chatroom message…

description.en: Voice call assistant for the DSH desktop app and the Web GUI (the same plugin, only the profile name differs): a draggable floating call ball, browser-side VAD…

description.en: Interior and exterior ballistics paper reproduction and code generation skill. Requires LibreOffice Kit for PDF rendering and a vision API key (e.g. Qwen-VL)…

description.en: Runs commands as background jobs that keep executing when DSH exits, with an optional sandbox to constrain file effects, plus a live web panel and offline…

description.en: Enhanced model selector for the DSH composer with searchable provider groups, keyboard and accessibility support, and an inline reasoning-effort slider.
description.zh: 增强 DSH 输入区的模型选择器：可搜索供应商分组、键盘与无障碍支持，以及内联推理强度滑杆。

description.en: Native desktop notifications for DSH — approvals, questions, turn completion, session end and errors — with click-to-session, per-event toggles, quiet hours, a…
description.zh: DSH 桌面通知：审批、提问、轮次完成、会话结束与出错时弹系统原生通知，点击直达对应会话；六类事件分别开关，支持免打扰时段与隐藏正文的隐私开关，并按事件类型合成提示音。

description.en: Sidebar Git panel for the DSH web GUI: Local Changes and All Commits views, branch, tag and stash management with fetch, pull and push dialogs, merge with…
description.zh: DSH 网页端的侧栏 Git 面板：Local Changes 与 All Commits 视图，分支、标签与 Stash 管理，fetch、pull、push 弹窗，带冲突处理的合并，以及输入框上的 zsh 风格分支标记。

description.en: Composer GitHub picker: click the GitHub icon at the bottom-right of the input box to search the workspace repository's issues and pull requests via the gh…

description.zh: 把 Magpie 网关的模型接入 DSH 选择器，支持模型显隐管理、图片输入与思考档位。

description.en: Agent skill and tool for querying multi-platform model account balances: DeepSeek, Doubao / Volcengine, Qwen / Alibaba Cloud, Hunyuan / Tencent Cloud, and…
description.zh: 多平台余额 Agent 技能与工具：查询 DeepSeek、豆包 / 火山引擎、千问 / 阿里云百炼、混元 / 腾讯云以及自定义 HTTP 接口的账户余额；只读，内置 60 秒缓存。

description.en: Cost panel for DeepSeek Harness: meters every request from session events, prices it against a built-in catalog of 136 models across 16 providers, and shows…
description.zh: DSH 费用统计面板：从 session 事件采集每次请求用量，按内置 16 家厂商 136 个模型的价格目录实时计费，在输入框旁展示当前模型、账户余额、本会话/今日/本月消费与月度预算横条。中英双语。

description.en: A helmeted pixel chicken rides a bicycle along a Minecraft-style pixel strip docked at the bottom of the app frame, with an 80-second day/night cycle, bell…
description.zh: 一只戴头盔的像素小鸡骑行在 GUI 底部的我的世界像素风骑行带里，带 80 秒昼夜循环、按铃音符、跳跃、车头灯与骑行统计。白天苦力怕出没，夜晚僵尸被撞飞。需要 DSH >=0.2.1-alpha。

description.en: Connect DeepSeek Harness Web to MySQL, MariaDB, PostgreSQL, SQL Server, Oracle and MongoDB for schema discovery and read-only queries through…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 数据库插件：统一管理 MySQL、MariaDB、PostgreSQL、SQL Server、Oracle 和 MongoDB 连接，让 Agent 按会话授权探索数据结构、执行只读查询并辅助数据分析。

description.en: Reusable Agent Team presets for DeepSeek Harness: a Settings page stores named Teams — a captain with its own prompt and tool allow-list, plus members carrying…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的可复用智能体团队预设：设置页保存具名团队——队长带自己的提示词与工具白名单，成员各自带 provider/模型路由、推理强度、提示词与工具——编辑器栏的团队控件把选中的团队应用到当前会话，安装队长提示词，并注册 spawn_team_member、get_team_preset、up…

description.en: Early-stage plugin connecting DeepSeek Harness to a separately deployed, self-hosted OwnDsh server for team identity, model access control, quotas, and usage…
description.zh: 早期开发中的团队管理插件，将 DeepSeek Harness 接入独立部署的自托管 OwnDsh 服务端，提供团队身份、模型授权、配额与用量审计。

description.en: Focus mode with a full-screen reading overlay that hides the header and composer and folds AI tool calls into summaries.
description.zh: 专注模式：全屏阅读视图，隐藏标题与输入区，把 AI 工具调用折叠成摘要。

description.en: Workspace-wide sticky notes on an infinite canvas: notes are plain Markdown files, created manually, captured from conversations, or distilled by the AI, and…
description.zh: 工作区级的无限画布便签：便签以 Markdown 文件保存，可手动创建、从对话中摘录或由 AI 提炼生成，并能作为上下文提供给 AI 使用；附带 12 个模型工具与 5 个内置技能，用于创建、打标签、整理、比较与合并便签。

description.en: Per-project MCP servers: a project declares servers in its own documents (`.dsh/mcp.json` by default; the local and global file lists are settings), and they…
description.zh: 按项目挂载 MCP 服务器：项目在自己的文档里声明服务器（默认 `.dsh/mcp.json`，本地与全局文件列表均为配置项），只对在该项目中工作的会话挂载——会话首个 turn 时挂载，空闲后释放。右侧栏标签页与设置页列出每个有活动会话的项目、各服务器状态以及持有挂载的会话，并提供 `Sync` / `Retry`…

description.en: DSH context insight panel: Context dashboard + /context command + Context browser — one-stop context lifecycle management with categorized composition, content…
description.zh: DSH 上下文洞察面板：Context 仪表盘 + /context命令 + Context 浏览器，查看 Context的分类组成、内容详情、演进趋势、压缩/注入事件、统计等一站式 Context 全生命周期管理。

description.en: Replaces the built-in DSH compaction summarizer with a five-section handoff summary and keeps every shadowed message readable in a segment directory.
description.zh: 接管 DSH 自带的压缩摘要器，改用五段式交接摘要，被压掉的每条消息都能在分段目录里读回。

description.zh: 远程开发启动器：通过 SSH（或本机 WSL 发行版）在远端引导安装 dsh，从本地客户端连接，LLM 凭据经反向隧道代理、不离开本机。同时提供独立 CLI 与 dsh 插件双形态，插件含远程会话面板、/remote-explorer 命令及 remote_* agent 工具。

description.en: Skill-driven harness/loop engineering workflow agent plugin.
description.zh: 技能驱动的 harness/loop 工程化工作流插件。

description.en: Six-player no-limit Texas Hold'em for the dsh Web GUI. One human plays against five LLM agents that each see only their own hole cards. Adds a dedicated tab…
description.zh: 六人无限注德州扑克：1 名玩家对 5 位只能看到自己底牌的 LLM 智能体。在 Web GUI 中提供独立 Tab 与会话区可拖拽悬浮小窗，支持按浏览器隔离的牌局与 CSRF 防护、按底池倍数给出的加注尺度、每人 3 次买入后出局，以及摊牌亮牌与公共牌翻牌动效。

description.en: Local Markdown long-term memory for DSH: an Obsidian-compatible vault, a sidebar management page, four memory tools, and budgeted per-turn recall.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供本地 Markdown 长期记忆：Obsidian 兼容仓库、侧边栏管理页、四个记忆工具，以及按预算的每回合召回。

description.en: Configurable image recognition for text-only DSH models: attached images are preserved through the DSH 0.1.7-rc.2 adapter pipeline, transcribed by an…
description.zh: 为纯文本 DSH 模型增加可配置识图能力：在 DSH 0.1.7-rc.2 中，上传图片会完整通过适配链路，由 OpenAI 兼容视觉模型转写为文字后交给主模型；支持 OpenAI / Anthropic / Gemini / Azure 风格密钥鉴权，缺少 API Key 时会在发起请求前明确提示。

description.en: Switchable web-search provider for DSH: native DeepSeek web search or an OpenAI-compatible custom backend. Installation automatically routes DSH web searches…
description.zh: 安装后自动将 DSH 网页搜索路由到本插件；只需配置服务商、API Key 和模型即可使用。支持 DeepSeek 原生搜索与 OpenAI 兼容自定义后端，已发布为 npm 包 @lp181818/web-search-advanced@0.1.3。

description.en: Tri-channel task notifications: in-page toasts with chimes, browser OS banners, and host-direct OS toasts that keep working with the browser closed, plus a…

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to Busabase: search workspace knowledge, work with structured records and apps, submit writes as reviewable ChangeRequests, and…

description.zh: 在会话开始时向模型注入用户设定的“必须做 / 不能做”持久要求。

description.en: Moves selected messages from one conversation into another, and manages a workspace's conversations with archive, restore, delete and move between workspaces.
description.zh: 把选中的消息从一个对话迁移到另一个对话，并管理工作区的对话——支持归档、还原、删除和跨工作区迁移。

description.en: Consistency guard for long-form writing: scans conversation prose for character, timeline and numeric setting conflicts across chapters, then jumps straight to…

description.en: Conversation timeline dock bar for DeepSeek Harness: a turn-level timeline above the composer with user-prompt hover tooltips and click-to-jump back to the…

description.zh: 通过版本化 JSONL 进程协议将 Multica 接入 DeepSeek Harness。

description.zh: 通过本地 WebSocket 桥接让 DSH 操控你的真实 Chrome：标签页管理、导航、DOM 快照、页面 JS 求值、点击输入、截图、等待与弹窗处理，默认关闭需在设置中开启。

description.en: Claude Code-style full-screen terminal UI: pixel-whale header, live status line, and streaming thought expansion.
description.zh: Claude Code 风格全屏终端 UI：像素鲸鱼顶栏、实时工作状态行、思考流式展开。

description.en: Activity overview pane for the DSH web UI: running, awaiting-response and recent sessions with child agents, progress, model and reasoning level in one sidebar…

description.en: Pinned prompt shortcuts in a single row above the composer — one click replaces the draft with the saved text — plus a searchable panel for pinning, editing…

description.en: Provisions the kimi-webbridge bridge daemon (auto-install with SHA-256 verification, auto-start) and registers a 25-action skill that drives the user's real…
