description.zh: ikun 桌宠填满「Deep diving...」状态行下方整行区块：坤宠动图沿 0%→100% 进度条行走，每 20% 切换动作与文案，完成时系统级播放「你干嘛~哎哟」提示音。

description.en: Sidebar panel for account balances and local token usage, with provider/model breakdowns and a 27-week daily heatmap.
description.zh: 侧边栏面板展示账户余额与本地 Token 用量，包含供应商/模型明细和 27 周每日热力图。

description.en: SillyTavern-style prompt rules for DSH: layered system-prompt anchors, constant/keyword entries, reproducible probability gates and regex rewriting.
description.zh: 类世界书的 DSH 提示词规则：分层系统提示锚点、蓝绿灯条目、可复现概率门与正则替换。

description.en: Four palettes for the DeepSeek Harness web UI — solid, glass, volume and neon — each with light and dark halves. Neon adds a scene light field with a 46px…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web UI 的四套配色：实心 / 玻璃 / 体积 / 霓虹，各含明暗两半。霓虹版在整窗场景光场上叠 46px 电路网格，并在模型运行时让一条激光扫描线扫过对话列（停止即消失）；侧栏工作区名为青色 HUD 标牌，界面拉丁字体内置 MiSans，侧栏字号固定 125% 且不随对话区缩放。

description.en: Circuit breaker for idle agent turns: watches agent/assistant-stream and cancels a turn that produces only reasoning — no text and no tool call — after 45s,…
description.zh: 空转回合熔断器：监听 agent/assistant-stream，对只产出 reasoning、零文本零工具调用的回合实施三重熔断——45 秒无进展、单次思考超 80000 字符、或命中退化重复模式（精确重复单元/句模重复/稀疏复读/6-gram 密度）。熔断后注入继续指令，要求下一个动作必须是工具调用；附 11…

description.en: Claude Code style /init command and tool that writes a minimal CLAUDE.md and symlinks AGENTS.md to it.
description.zh: 提供 Claude Code 风格的 /init 命令与工具，生成极简 CLAUDE.md，并将 AGENTS.md 以相对软链指向它。

description.en: Tailscale remote-access operations panel for the dsh web GUI: health checks, HTTPS entry toggle via tailscale serve, macOS proxy bypass, relay server ops, and…
description.zh: Tailscale 远程访问运维面板：健康检查、HTTPS 入口（tailscale serve）开关、macOS 代理绕过、中继服务器运维与 ACL 片段生成。

description.en: dsh port of the shared handoff kit: handoff and task-id-bootstrap skills plus host-side automation — baseline state injection, per-turn snapshots with an Auto…
description.zh: 共享交接套件的 dsh 版:handoff 与 task-id-bootstrap 技能 + host 侧自动化——基线状态注入、每轮快照与 Auto Log 轨迹、task=<id> 路由、续接关键词重注入、达阈值报警的压缩守护、子代理只读保护;与 Codex、Claude、pi 版写同一份…

description.en: Cache-stable progressive tool discovery: a fixed tool_search and tool_dispatch surface on every request, in-memory catalog search, nested dispatch through the…
description.zh: 缓存稳定的渐进式工具发现：每次请求使用固定的 tool_search 与 tool_dispatch 工具面，从内存目录搜索后经 Harness 管线分发，发现过程中原生工具列表保持字节稳定。

description.en: One-click native conversations with independent workspaces for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供一键原生对话入口，每次创建独立工作区和会话。

description.en: Labnana image generation for DeepSeek Harness: text-to-image / image-to-image / precise editing with credits estimation, subscription balance and web settings…
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 Labnana 图片生成：文生图 / 图生图 / 精准编辑，含积分预估、余额查询与网页设置界面。

description.en: Asks System One models for yes/no, choice, score, and image-box judgments with probabilities, via an agent tool or a plugin service.
description.zh: 调用 System One 模型做是非、选择、评分和图片定位判断并返回概率，提供 agent 工具和插件服务。

description.en: Read-only Git and SVN code review using the current DSH agent model, with change previews, explicit context and approval-gated model requests.
description.zh: 复用当前 DSH Agent 模型只读审查 Git 与 SVN 变更，支持变更预览、显式上下文及经审批的模型请求。

description.en: Read-only Git and SVN change review inside DeepSeek Harness, with repository browsing and side-by-side diffs.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 内只读审阅 Git 与 SVN 变更，支持仓库浏览和并排差异对比。

description.en: Pre-boot health checks and repair for dsh plugin trees — ten static scan rules that follow the launcher runtime resolution, fault attribution after a failed…
description.zh: dsh 插件树的启动前体检与修复——十条跟随启动器运行时解析的静态规则、启动失败后的故障归因、先在隔离实例复验再落地的白名单可逆修复、点名目标版本会跳过哪些插件的升级预演，以及带插件行管理面板与历次故障 RAG 知识库的设置界面。

description.en: Real-time usage, cost and balance meter for DeepSeek Harness: official-API balance, cost accuracy within ¥0.02, per-turn / per-session / per-model cost ledger,…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 实时用量、费用与余额计量：官方 API 实时查询余额、计费误差 0.02 元内，分本轮/本次会话/整个模型三级费用台账，实时分色档位 Token 速度，输入框旁弹窗即点即看。

description.en: Forces context compression when running low-context llama.cpp models such as Qwen3.8-27B, improving model efficiency and usage smoothness, together with…
description.zh: llama-cpp qwen3.8-27b 低上下文时，强制上下文压缩插件，提示模型使用效率和使用流畅度，外加完善的压缩提示。

description.en: Plays a short synthesized ding in the browser tab the moment an agent finishes a turn, built entirely with the Web Audio API; no backend audio and no OS…
description.zh: agent 回合结束时在浏览器标签页里播放一声合成的叮,纯前端 Web Audio 发音,不经过后端、不弹系统通知。

description.en: Draggable floating cat-or-dog companion for the dsh web GUI that changes expression with the session and is configured on a Companion settings page.
description.zh: 可拖拽的猫狗悬浮伴侣，表情随当前会话变化，在 Companion 设置页里换皮肤。

description.en: Deterministic context compression for dsh — zero LLM calls, rule-based pruning that preserves paths, commands, error traces, and open todos verbatim.…
description.zh: dsh 的确定性上下文压缩后端：零 LLM 摘要调用，基于规则剪枝，逐字保留路径/命令/报错原文/未完成 todo，约 8 万 token 压到几百。

description.en: Register locally-defined custom agents as callable subagents in dsh: the main conversation invokes any agent by name via use_agent, each running as a real dsh…
description.zh: 把本地定义的自定义 agent 注册成 dsh 可调用的 subagent：主模型通过 use_agent 工具按名字派活，每个 agent 以独立人格运行，支持断点续跑。

description.en: Full-featured TUI for DeepSeek Harness: streaming conversation, powerline status bar, real-time think/tool/todo panels, subagent dual-view, theme hot-switch —…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的全功能 TUI：流式对话、powerline 状态栏、实时思考/工具/待办面板、子代理双视图、主题热切换——全部以纯 cordis 插件实现，不 fork、不 patch 上游一行代码。

description.en: Local-first usage and cost meter for the DSH web UI: composer button with live session cost and balance; panel with a stacked per-model daily/7-day chart…
description.zh: 本地优先的用量与费用仪表：输入框下方按钮显示实时费用与余额，面板含按模型堆叠的当日/近 7 天柱状图（按刊例价生效区间计价、官方定价页每日同步）、本月消耗段位与画布分享卡片、30/50/85% 上下文压力三档预警与一键 /compact、预算提醒，以及面板内 npm 检查更新与一键更新。

description.en: Windows system-tray launcher for dsh web: console-free background start (VBS/powershell chain), a tray menu with open UI / logs / icon presets /…
description.zh: Windows 系统托盘启动器：无窗口后台启动 dsh web（VBS/powershell 链），托盘菜单支持打开界面、日志、图标预设、开机自启与重启 Harness，一键安装与更新内置的 dsh-plugin-usage-meter，并可作为 dsh 插件安装使托盘随 Harness 一起启动。

description.en: Drive a local or remote ComfyUI server from DeepSeek Harness: comfyui_run / comfyui_object_info / comfyui_workflow tools generate and edit images and videos,…
description.zh: 让 DeepSeek Harness 的 Agent 直接驱动本地或远程 ComfyUI：comfyui_run / comfyui_object_info / comfyui_workflow 工具生成与编辑图像、视频，附带工作流库（图工作流提取：按分量 / 主流程 / 整体）、加载区分辨率自动匹配、实时队列、SDX…

description.en: Speaks your agent's reports in a voice you choose, compressing long reports before speaking. Character voices need no training - a 3-10 second reference clip…
description.zh: 让你的 DSH 用你喜欢的声音开口说话、汇报内容，过长的汇报先压缩再念。角色声线不需要自己训练：一段 3-10 秒参考音就能克隆，也能直接用别人训练好的模型；不必为此装一整套 6.4 GB 的 GPT-SoVITS —— 运行时和声线都由插件自己装好。已有 GPT-SoVITS 的话也能直接接上，两者跑的是同一套声线。

description.en: Configurable send and newline keys, a composer context menu with three sources (leave it to DSH and other plugins / browser menu / plugin-styled custom menu),…
description.zh: 可配置发送/换行键位、输入框右键菜单三种来源（插件不介入 / 浏览器菜单 / 自定义样式菜单）、带分类的快捷指令面板（每条可设「每次发送都附加」或「仅在本会话第一条消息附加」，并有跨分类移动与新建）、用另一次模型调用把草稿整理成清晰指令的提示词优化、设置面板尺寸记忆，并为 OpenCode 路由自动注入…

description.en: During long agent thinking, posts a hot-news or reminder message directly into the conversation stream.
description.zh: agent 思考超时时，直接在对话流中推出一条今日头条热点或提醒消息。

description.en: PTES-based penetration testing plugin with Root-Orchestrator architecture for DeepSeek Harness.
description.zh: 基于 PTES 的渗透测试插件，采用 Root-Orchestrator 架构，用于 DeepSeek Harness。

description.en: Sound reminders with one-click jump for concurrent sessions: the current session gets crisp dang/dang-dang tones, other sessions a soft ding/ding-ding plus a…
description.zh: 多对话并行的声音提醒 + 对话直达：当前对话当/当当（crisp 清脆档），其他对话叮/叮叮（soft 柔和档）+ 右上角小卡片，点一下直达对应对话。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness control center for official balance monitoring, per-session costs and tokens, third-party token totals, completion alerts, official recharge,…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 监控、提醒、充值与会话控制中心：查看官方余额、本会话花费与 token、第三方 token 合计，提供完成提醒、官方充值、灵活布局及 Agent 辅助的会话控制。

description.en: Type normally; about two seconds after you pause, it rewrites your draft into a version more likely to get a good answer, leaving pasted code, links and long…
description.zh: 你只管正常打字，停下约两秒，它就把你刚写的话自动改写成更容易得到好答案的样子；贴进来的代码、网址、长文原样不动，一次问几件事也一件不漏、排好顺序。

description.en: Highlights answered ask blocks (question n/n answered) in the conversation with a soft card style; pending asks and other tool blocks keep their native look.
description.zh: 提问块高亮：把对话里已答复的「提问 n/n 已回答」工具块用柔和卡片样式凸显；等待中的提问块与其它工具块保持原样。

description.en: Web GUI enhancement bundle: a standalone password gateway with optional HTTPS for LAN and remote access, PWA install and icons, and desktop plus Web Push…
description.zh: DSH 增强套件：为 Web GUI 提供独立的密码访问网关（可选 HTTPS，适合局域网/远程访问），整合 PWA 安装与图标、桌面通知与 Web Push，并在设置页统一配置。

description.en: PWA icon: sets the icon (and manifest app name) used when the Web GUI is installed or added to the desktop; ships a default icon set and accepts a custom image.
description.zh: PWA 图标：把 Web GUI 安装/添加到桌面时使用的图标（以及 manifest 应用名）换成自定义内容，包内自带默认图标集，也可配置自己的图片。

description.en: Portrait layout for desktop windows: navigation takes the full left column, the file/terminal panel moves above the conversation, and a draggable splitter sets…
description.zh: 竖屏布局：电脑竖屏窗口下，导航占左列整高，文件/终端面板移到对话区上方，中间的分隔线可拖拽调整高度；手机/平板不受影响。

description.en: Animated and video live wallpaper for the DeepSeek Harness Web GUI — GIF, animated WebP/APNG and static PNG/JPEG images, plus MP4/WebM video backgrounds, with…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 界面动态壁纸插件：支持 GIF / 动图 WebP / APNG 与静态 PNG/JPG 图片，以及 MP4 / WebM 视频背景，格式自动识别，自带压暗与亮度调节，可让界面色调跟随背景。

description.en: Sidebar session-title icons: an auxiliary model call on the same route as title generation draws a 24x24 monochrome SVG metaphor shown before each session row…
description.zh: 侧边栏会话标题图标：标题生成时用同一路由的辅助模型调用画一枚 24×24 单色 SVG 隐喻图标，显示在每行标题左侧，带磁盘缓存。

description.en: Classic Macintosh (System 7) pixel theme: desktop pattern canvas, Finder sidebar, monochrome buttons and dialogs, light/dark support.
description.zh: 经典麦金塔 System 7 像素风主题：桌面网点画布、Finder 侧栏、黑白按钮与弹窗，深浅色随官方外观切换。

description.en: The session page has an extra "Git" page; on the left is a preview of the non-staged/staged changes, and on the right is a diff preview with a row-level action…
description.zh: 会话页里多出一个 Git 页；左侧是未暂存 / 已暂存的改动，右侧是带行级操作条（暂存 / 丢弃）的 diff 预览。

description.en: Offline voice input for the DSH Web UI: mic to local FunASR (SenseVoiceSmall), one-click install, no cloud.
description.zh: DSH Web 本地离线语音输入：麦克风经本地 FunASR（SenseVoiceSmall）识别后填入输入框，支持一键安装，全程离线。

description.en: Links DeepSeek Harness to VS Code: approvals answered in native notifications, ask_user_question answered in a sidebar card, an ide_context tool fed by the…
description.zh: 把 DSH 接进 VS Code：审批用原生通知回答，ask_user_question 在侧边栏卡片里作答，ide_context 工具读取当前文件、诊断与选区，选区可插入 DSH 输入框，侧边栏提供实时转录、按工作区限定的会话列表以及模型与权限控制。

description.en: Predicts the user's next prompt after each assistant reply and shows it as gray ghost text inside the composer; accept it whole with Tab, accept it piece by…
description.zh: 助手回复结束后预测用户的下一句话，以灰色 ghost text 浮在输入框里；Tab 整条采纳、Alt+→ 逐段采纳、↻ 换一条、Esc 忽略。

description.en: Dot-matrix backdrop for the DSH Web UI: the dots form the DeepSeek whale or a transparent PNG you import (alpha-masked), each dot carries its own low-frequency…
description.zh: 给 DSH Web 加一层点阵背景:点阵可组成鲸鱼剪影,或导入透明 PNG 按 alpha 取主体;每颗粒子各自持有低频外力,手动模式下跟随光标扰动,自动屏保模式则用 360° 任意方向的扫波与全屏呼吸带动整幅图案;鼠标/自动与鲸鱼/照片在参数面板里切换,入口在 设置 → 插件。

description.en: Adaptive topology multi-agent preset for DeepSeek Harness with peer messaging, task handoff and live network visualization.
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的自适应拓扑多智能体预设，提供点对点通信、任务交接和实时网络可视化。

description.en: Spec-Driven Development pipeline for Odoo: 15 tools take a request from an immutable spec through architecture to module code or live configuration, then…
description.zh: 面向 Odoo 的规范驱动开发流水线：15 个工具把需求从不可变规范推进到架构、再到模块代码或线上配置，最终要求一个由真实 Odoo 实例证据支撑的持久判定；闸门 fail-closed，批量操作需在声明的环境中经人工批准，复用 Odoo 自带的 CSV／Excel 导入器，并有一份可回滚本插件所写数据的日志。

description.en: Input prediction: the likely continuation of your draft appears as grey ghost text after the caret and Tab accepts it, and after each assistant turn 1-3…
description.zh: 输入预测：在输入框里用灰字续写你草稿最可能的后续，按 Tab 接受后落进输入框、可继续编辑；每轮回答结束后在输入框上方给出 1–3 条你可能会发的下一条，点一下就发送。灰字补全、回复后推荐与推荐条数都能在「设置 → 内置插件 → 输入预测」里开关。

description.en: QA pipeline as 10 agent skills: requirement analysis, test strategy, case writing and review, E2E (Playwright) and API automation, exploratory, regression…
description.zh: 软件测试全流程技能包：10 个技能覆盖需求分析、测试策略、用例编写与审查、E2E（Playwright）与 API 自动化、探索式测试、回归范围与 Bug 分析，共享知识库提供格式规范、风险模型与 Schema 校验脚本。

description.en: Resumes turns interrupted by a DSH host restart: hooks agent activation (once a session is live), reads the crash-repair turn/end, and sends a continuation…
description.zh: DSH 重启后自动续跑被中断的回合：在会话激活后读取崩溃修复写入的 turn/end，投出要求先核对真实状态（不假定外部操作成功或失败）的续跑消息；永久性失败（认证、配额、上下文超限）直接跳过，并有跨重启次数预算、自适应退避与最小上下文注入。

description.en: Voice announcements when a conversation ends (session title, round, outcome) plus live sentence-by-sentence reading of replies, via built-in edge-tts with zero…
description.zh: 对话结束语音播报（会话名、轮数、结果），回复生成时实时逐句朗读；内置 edge-tts，零第三方依赖。

description.en: Connect multiple Overleaf projects to DSH through OverleafMCP for browsing, analysis, and Git-based file updates.
description.zh: 通过 OverleafMCP 将多个 Overleaf 项目接入 DSH，支持浏览、分析和通过 Git 写回 LaTeX 文件。

description.en: Cross-session memory vault: remember / recall / forget tools, per-turn prompt injection, and a settings-page entry browser.
description.zh: 跨会话记忆库：remember / recall / forget 工具、每轮提示注入与设置页条目浏览。

description.en: Multi-machine remote workspace: manage many SSH hosts, pick a local or remote workspace in the native Add-workspace flow (system folder chooser / local path /…
description.zh: 多机远程工作区：管理多台 SSH 主机，在原生「添加工作区」流程里选本机系统文件夹或远程目录，把远程工作区镜像成真实本地文件夹并用 rw_* 工具操作。选择器是居中弹窗，默认落在本机页签，远程路径自动预填 `/` 并逐级自动补全目录。

description.en: A fork of Microsoft's official .NET/C# skills for AI coding agents, additionally packaged as a DeepSeek Harness plugin — covering development, testing,…
description.zh: 微软官方 .NET/C# AI 编码智能体技能的 fork，额外打包为 DeepSeek Harness 插件——覆盖开发、测试、诊断、迁移与 AI 集成。

description.en: Multi-backend web_search provider (Exa + Firecrawl) for the built-in web_search tool, with automatic failover, per-backend 429 cooldowns, and key-free…
description.zh: 面向内置 web_search 工具的多后端搜索提供方（Exa + Firecrawl）：自动故障切换、按后端 429 冷却、无密钥匿名可用。

description.en: AI research toolkit for DSH: a model release radar, a per-model benchmark and community report from 13 structured leaderboards plus Chinese and English…
description.zh: DSH 的 AI 研究工具箱：模型发布雷达、单模型跑分与口碑体检（13 路结构化榜单 + 中英文社区讨论）、覆盖 46 个 Feed 与 22 个官方 X 账号的 AI 新闻雷达；注册 4 个工具 + 3 个技能，报告统一渲染为带目录的 Markdown。

description.en: Ctrl+F find-in-session for the conversation, powered by the session store rather than the DOM - labels every hit by source (you / assistant / reasoning / tool…
description.zh: 会话内 Ctrl+F 全文查找（读会话 store 而非 DOM）：命中按来源分类（你/助手/思考/工具调用/工具输出/系统）、按轮次分组、同文合并，可切「只搜正文 / 搜全部内容」，支持正则/大小写/全词，全量高亮，并能把结果复制或导出为 Markdown。

description.en: Adds a Codex-style message navigation rail for quickly locating earlier prompts in long DeepSeek Harness Web UI conversations.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness Web UI 添加 Codex 风格的消息导航轨道，方便在长会话中快速定位历史提问。

description.en: An editable diagram canvas in the DSH sidebar plus two agent tools (diagram_read, diagram_apply) that read and edit the workspace in place, using native…
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏的可编辑画布，加两个模型工具（diagram_read、diagram_apply），直接读写工作区、载体是原生 .drawio 文件：无损写回让画布读不懂的单元逐字节保留，文件指纹 revision 支撑起对并发编辑的乐观锁。

description.en: An F1 Race Control theme for DSH Web with four switchable team skins, broadcast-photo backgrounds, light and dark modes, and native appearance controls.
description.zh: 一款适用于 DSH Web 的 F1 赛事控制中心主题，提供四支车队皮肤、赛事摄影背景、浅色与深色模式及原生外观设置。

description.en: Connect ChatGPT OAuth and OpenAI Codex models to DeepSeek Harness, with opt-in search and image tools.
description.zh: 通过 ChatGPT OAuth 将 OpenAI Codex 模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，并提供可选的搜索与图片工具。

description.en: Visual branch brainstorming that creates an isolated Session for each direction, automates parent, sibling, checkpoint, and return Handoffs, and provides a…
description.zh: 可视化分支头脑风暴：为每个方向创建独立 Session，自动处理父子继承、兄弟感知、进展与回传 Handoff，并提供完整树形 Tab 与可选 Better Sidebar 右栏。

description.en: ShiGuang Memory Engine (SGME) bridge: multi-agent shared long-term memory via HTTP — L0/L1/L1.5/L2 distillation, scenario-based injection, unified search, and…
description.zh: 拾光记忆引擎（SGME）桥接：多智能体共享长期记忆（HTTP）—— L0/L1/L1.5/L2 分层提炼、按场景注入、统一检索、主动关怀信号（memory_search / wiki_search / signal_pull / signal_claim / signal_ack），npm 包名 `dsh-sgme`。

description.en: Reuses the CodeBuddy CLI sign-in to bring its models into DeepSeek Harness, with a settings card showing account, token expiry, and remaining credit.
description.zh: 复用 CodeBuddy CLI 的登录态，把 CodeBuddy 包含的模型接入 DeepSeek Harness，设置卡片可查看账号、令牌有效期与剩余积分。

description.en: Concurrency guard and monitor for DeepSeek Harness: FIFO queue when concurrent model requests reach the limit, per-day persisted stats with error-kind…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 并发监控与门闩：模型请求达上限时 FIFO 排队防锁号，按天持久化统计并做异常分类，检测流被弃用的回合中断。

description.en: Manual model probe for DeepSeek Harness: a session-view tab where you pick provider, API type, model and route, then send one real raw HTTP request over…
description.zh: DSH 模型健康检查：会话视图页签内按「供应商 → API 类型 → 模型 → 路由」选定目标，手动发一条真实裸 HTTP 请求（支持 openai-completions / openai-responses / anthropic-messages 三协议，流式可切），一屏看清耗时、TTFT、HTTP…

description.en: Local token usage and cost dashboard for DeepSeek Harness: four-segment token breakdown (miss/cache-hit/cache-write/output), cache savings estimate against the…
description.zh: DSH 本地 Token 用量与成本统计仪表盘：四段 Token 构成（未命中/缓存命中/缓存写入/输出）、按未命中与命中的价差估算缓存省钱、会话下钻（上下文增长曲线与异常激增标记）、全局筛选可分享 URL、月度预算环形进度与月底外推、日/月聚合快路径查询（O(天数)）+ 增量扫描。

description.en: Opens the DSH settings dialog as a full-page screen and moves the close control to a back row at the top left.
description.zh: 让 DSH 的设置弹窗以整页全屏打开，并把退出入口移到左上角的返回行。

description.en: Manage MCP servers and skills from a panel in the DSH sidebar: edit rows in the profile or global cordis.patch.yml, toggle them, check whether an HTTP server…
description.zh: 在 DSH 侧边栏的面板里管理 MCP 服务器与技能：编辑 profile 或全局 cordis.patch.yml 中的行、启用停用、探测 HTTP 服务器是否响应、扫描 Claude Code / Codex / Cursor / Gemini 的配置并导入其中声明的服务器，以及浏览、新建、编辑、启停与删除技能（直…

description.en: Functy fork of corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect. Brings WorkBuddy desktop-app models into DeepSeek Harness with a dashboard UI, multi-account rotation, and…
description.zh: corrinehu/dsh-workbuddy-connect 的 Functy 分支。把 WorkBuddy 桌面 App 的模型接到 DeepSeek Harness，带仪表盘界面、多账号轮换和侧栏额度。

description.en: Command Code balance and quota panel: a status row under the composer showing the available balance and the 5-hour, weekly and monthly windows.
description.zh: Command Code 余额与额度面板：在输入框下方显示可用余额，以及 5 小时、每周、每月三个额度窗口。

description.en: Composer and sidebar helpers in one plugin, each switchable in Settings: a git Changes panel (uncommitted / unstaged / staged / branch diffs), ↑/↓ input…
description.zh: 一个插件集成多项输入框与侧边栏增强，均可在设置中单独开关：git 改动面板（未提交 / 未暂存 / 已暂存 / 分支差异）、↑/↓ 输入历史、Shift+Tab 切换 /plan、对话中断或失败后一键 ▶ 继续、拖拽调整排队消息顺序、复制会话链接、Auto Review「本对话内允许」、项目状态标记与活跃项目置顶、后台…

description.en: Session header badge showing DeepSeek peak/off-peak status, per-model token prices on hover, and real session/turn costs from actual usage.
description.zh: 会话头部徽标：显示 DeepSeek 高峰/闲时状态、当前模型 token 单价，并按真实用量统计会话与每轮费用。

description.en: Agent-managed procedural memory: a skill_manage tool that creates, patches, disables and deletes the agent's own skills in user or project scope, with delete…
description.zh: 代理自管的程序性记忆：skill_manage 工具可创建、修补、禁用、删除 agent 自己的技能（用户级/项目级双作用域），带删除守卫（agent 创建标记、pin、路径限制）与触发纪律提示。

description.en: Windows desktop shortcut for dsh web: launches the server, auto-opens the browser when ready, and stops the service when the Harness window closes.
description.zh: Windows 桌面快捷方式：一键启动 dsh web，就绪后自动打开浏览器，关闭 Harness 窗口即停服务。

description.en: Superself's self CLI as model-facing tools (project context, work units, reports, decisions) plus a /self command — cross-session, cross-project project state…
description.zh: 把 Superself 的 self CLI 暴露为模型工具（项目上下文、工作单元、报告、决策）并提供 /self 命令——跨会话、跨项目的项目状态，保存在代码仓库之外。

description.en: Side chats and selection annotations for DeepSeek Harness, preserving full conversation history and bringing findings back to the main thread.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供侧边追问与划选注释，保留完整对话历史，将结论带回主线。

description.en: Renders live multi-agent session activity as a pixel-art office in a Web UI side panel - each session is an ox/horse worker typing at its desk when busy or…
description.zh: 把多 agent 会话的实时活动渲染成 Web UI 侧边栏里的像素风办公室--每个会话是一名牛/马员工，忙时伏案敲键盘、闲时起身摸鱼，支持点击查看工位监控、就地处理审批。

description.en: Self-hosted DSH Web operations panel for safe restart and upgrade, health diagnostics, model-usage statistics and provider quota lookup, backup and session…
description.zh: 面向自托管 DSH Web 的运维面板：安全重启与升级、健康诊断、模型用量统计与供应商额度查询、备份和会话管理、任务通知、技能控制、子代理模型路由与 Linux 权限维护。

description.en: Block-addressed document editing: an MCP server exposing geml_get / geml_set / geml_check and friends, so an agent reads or rewrites one addressed block of a…
description.zh: 按块寻址的文档读写：MCP server 提供 geml_get / geml_set / geml_check 等工具，Agent 只取回或改写 Markdown、GEML 文档中的某一个块，而不是整篇文件。另带 GEML 写作技能，以及把项目调用图构建为 GEML codemap 并浏览的代码图谱技能。

description.en: Policy plugin that gates kubectl by kubeconfig context: hard-deny irreversible verbs outside local clusters, ask for the rest.
description.zh: 按 kubeconfig context 管控 kubectl 调用的策略插件：本地集群外硬拒绝不可逆操作，其余写操作请求人工确认。

description.en: Windows desktop control exposed as native DSH tools - whole-screen and single-window capture (the window one goes through PrintWindow, so a covered window…
description.zh: 以 DSH 原生工具形式提供的 Windows 桌面控制——整屏与单窗口截图（单窗口走 PrintWindow，窗口被遮住也能抓）、点击、拖动、打字、按键、滚动、窗口管理、像素与窗口轮询，以及可直接 invoke 控件或读取控件值的 UIA 查询（不必点坐标）。13 个工具，跑在 PowerShell 7…

description.en: Ships a skill that documents how to build, debug and publish DSH plugins - host and client package skeleton, developing a forked plugin inside a throwaway…
description.zh: 携带一份技能，讲怎么开发、调试、发布 DSH 插件——host/client 双半包骨架、把 fork 挂进丢弃式 profile 开发、发布到 GitHub 与 npm，以及发布过程中实际踩到的坑。安装插件即注册该技能。

description.en: Ships a skill plus six Node scripts for a DSH install that will not come up - walking the boot stages before readiness, the plugin dependency bridges and…
description.zh: 携带一份技能加 6 个 Node 脚本，用来处理装完起不来的 DSH——沿 readiness 之前的引导阶段、profile 下的插件依赖桥与 junction、失效或重复的插件行、以及升级路径逐段排查。脚本默认只诊断，重建脚本只有显式加 --fix 才写盘。

description.en: Ships a skill about writing DSH skills - SKILL.md frontmatter and root precedence, how to phrase a description so it actually triggers, length and splitting…
description.zh: 携带一份讲怎么写 DSH 技能的技能——SKILL.md 的 frontmatter 与技能根优先级、description 怎么写才会被触发、篇幅与拆分标准，以及「写完后怎么证明它真管用」的 A/B 验证。包里还带着供这份技能校验技能目录的检查脚本。

description.en: Ships a skill about handing work to subagents instead of doing it inline - which tasks are worth fanning out, how many to run at once, how to send them in…
description.zh: 携带一份讲「什么该交给子 agent 做、而不是自己顺手做」的技能——哪些任务值得扇出、一次派几个、并行怎么发，以及子 agent 回来后怎么核对它真的做了什么，而不是信它的总结。

description.en: File-based cross-session memory: plain Markdown memory files with automatic retrieval injection, format-compatible with Claude Code's CLAUDE.md and memory…
description.zh: 基于文件的跨会话记忆：纯 Markdown 记忆文件，检索结果自动注入；格式与 Claude Code 的 CLAUDE.md 及记忆文件兼容，迁移即手工复制文件。

description.en: A time module in the DSH session header: current time, time since your last message, reminders, and countdowns. Pure browser-side - data lives in localStorage…
description.zh: DSH 会话头部的时间模块：现在时间、距你上次发言、提醒与倒计时。纯前端插件——数据存浏览器 localStorage，host 半不注册任何东西；到点提示是边框呼吸灯加界面浮条，不发系统通知。

description.en: Real PTY terminal panel for the DSH Web UI: host half spawns shells with node-pty (cmd.exe default on Windows), rendered in the browser with xterm.js;…
description.zh: DSH Web UI 终端面板：宿主端 node-pty 真实 PTY（Windows 默认 cmd.exe）+ 浏览器 xterm.js 渲染；多标签会话、停靠/浮动窗口、复制粘贴。

description.en: Renders mermaid fences in dsh web chat as SVG diagrams by default, with cursor-anchored smooth zoom and pan, a per-fence diagram/code toggle persisted in…
description.zh: 将 dsh Web 对话中的 mermaid 代码围栏默认渲染为 SVG 图表，支持以指针为锚点的丝滑缩放拖拽、按围栏记忆的图/文案切换（localStorage 持久化）、明暗主题跟随，以及完全本地打包的离线渲染引擎。

description.zh: 通过 MCP 将 DeepSeek Harness 连接到 Postiz：列出已连接的社交媒体渠道、获取各平台发帖规则，并向 X、LinkedIn、Instagram、Facebook、Threads、TikTok、YouTube、Reddit、Bluesky、Mastodon、Discord、Slack、Telegr…

description.en: Conversation navigator panel: turn-folded outline of the current session with per-step kind badges (assistant, tool, command, compaction, error), a hover…
description.zh: 会话导航面板：按轮折叠的当前会话大纲与步次类型徽标（助手/工具/命令/压缩/出错），悬停气泡显示用户提问全文，可隐藏轮次号的极简徽标视图，仅检索提问与助手回复的关键词过滤，点击跳转与阅读位置跟踪，支持加载更早/加载全部历史分页。宿主 ≥ 0.1.2-rc.1，旧宿主装 @legacy/0.2.5。

description.en: Local images and videos as the DSH desktop window background: timed rotation with 0.7s cross-fades, first-frame-ready before fading in, automatic light/dark…
description.zh: 把本机图片/视频（含 Dynamic Wallpaper.app 素材）用作 DSH 桌面客户端背景：定时轮换与 0.7 秒交叉淡化、等首帧就绪再淡入、按壁纸明暗自动切换深/浅字色、模糊与面板/侧栏透明度可调、视频缩略图，探针接口上报加载、图层与界面选择器的健康状态。只读取本机文件，不联网。

description.en: Bing-backed web search provider for the built-in web_search tool: prefers Bing's RSS feed with the public cn.bing.com HTML page as fallback, no API key,…
description.zh: 为内置 web_search 工具提供 Bing 搜索源：优先解析 Bing 的 RSS 输出，以 cn.bing.com 公开 HTML 结果页作为兜底，无需 API Key，国内可直连，搜索不再消耗模型自带的搜索额度。端点、结果数量与结果语言可配置；适配 DSH 0.2.x（0.1.7+ 亦可用）。

description.en: Preset engineering workflows for DeepSeek Harness: a dev_task tool that gates stage transitions, artifacts, verification, review and commit scope, plus a web…
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供预设工程流程：dev_task 工具把阶段流转、产物、验证、审核与提交范围做成硬门禁，并带一个安装项目级与个人级技能和规则的工作台。

description.en: Multi-agent frugality defense plugin: read-ledger dedup metrics, compaction-immune rules, completion gate, cheap-model review lane.
description.zh: 多智能体防内耗防御插件：读取台账去重度量、免疫压缩规则区、完成机械门禁、低成本审查 lane。

description.en: 273 ECC skills (95.8% of the 227k-star operator system) ported to DSH in four batches.
description.zh: ECC（227k⭐ 操作员系统）273 个技能（95.8%）分四批移植到 DSH。

description.en: Ponytail lazy senior dev mode: 6 skills adapted from DietrichGebert/ponytail.
description.zh: Ponytail 最懒资深工程师模式：6 个技能，改编自 DietrichGebert/ponytail。

description.en: Read-only repo bootstrap scanner (repo_setup_scan tool): detects stack/tests/docs/git/db and recommends plugins, MCP servers and hygiene files.
description.zh: 只读仓库体检引导工具（repo_setup_scan）：识别技术栈/测试/文档/git/数据库线索，给出插件、MCP 与卫生文件的安装建议。

description.en: Matt Pocock's 25 skills fully translated to Chinese (technical terms kept in English with glosses).
description.zh: Matt Pocock 25 个技能正文全译中文（技术术语保留英文并附注释）。

description.en: Matt Pocock full promoted skill set (25 SKILL.md: grilling, writing-for-agents, wait-what, TDD, code review, wayfinder, ask-matt router) ported to DSH.
description.zh: Matt Pocock 完整发布技能集（25 个 SKILL.md）的 DSH 移植。

description.en: Drive your dsh agent from WeChat over the iLink gateway: two-way encrypted media transfer (auto-decrypt inbox + /send), proactive weixin_send tool, completion…
description.zh: 微信遥控 DeepSeek Harness：iLink 双向加密文件收发（入站自动解密落盘 + /send 出站）、weixin_send 主动通知、完成通知、多会话切换、健康面板与文件日志。

description.en: Transparent image guard for text-only routes: paste images without the 400 session deadlock, plus a vision_analyze tool for OCR/PDF/docx/pptx/video.
description.zh: 纯文本路由的透明图片护栏：贴图不再 400 卡死会话，附带 vision_analyze 工具（OCR/PDF/docx/pptx/视频）。

description.en: Registers the RainSkills bootstrap skill in DeepSeek Harness for deploying, troubleshooting, and verifying applications on Rainbond.
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 注册 RainSkills 引导技能，用于通过 Rainbond 部署、排障和验证应用。

description.en: Stop a running background job from the session-header job list, with a confirmation dialog that restates the full command.
description.zh: 在会话头部的后台任务列表里停止正在运行的任务，确认弹窗会再次显示完整命令。

description.en: Adds human-facing TypeSafe Jev advice to DSH multiple-choice prompts, with recommendations, probabilities, confidence, close-call warnings, copyable…
description.zh: 为 DSH 选择题提供面向用户的 TypeSafe Jev 第二意见卡片，展示推荐、概率和置信度，支持推荐分歧提示、复制建议、一键采纳、按 profile 保存卡片位置与折叠状态及临时决策偏好，并提供可选发送前预览和常见凭证遮盖。

description.en: Routes DSH web search and fetch through configured providers and records per-attempt usage and estimated costs. Requires Node.js >=22.19 and DSH 0.2.1-rc.2.
description.zh: 按已配置渠道路由 DSH 网页搜索与抓取，并记录每次尝试的用量和估算费用。需 Node.js >=22.19 与 DSH 0.2.1-rc.2。

description.en: Local OCR fallback for text-only routes: when the session model declares it cannot accept images, the attached image is cached locally and its path injected so…
description.zh: 纯文本路由的本地 OCR 兜底：会话模型明确声明不接受图片时，把附件的图片存入本地缓存并注入路径，模型调 ocr_image 用 PP-OCRv5 + ONNX Runtime 在纯 CPU 上离线识别，无需 API key，图片不出本机；模型能看图时静默。

description.en: Connects DeepSeek Harness to a local SiYuan (思源笔记) desktop app: registers its note tools as mcp__siyuan__<tool>, exposes the AI configured in SiYuan together…
description.zh: 把 DeepSeek Harness 接到本机思源笔记桌面端：把笔记工具注册为 mcp__siyuan__<tool>，额外把思源里配置好的 AI 与其 agent 回路也做成一个工具（按档位门禁），附带笔记使用技能，并在每次调用上执行只读/创作/完整三级策略；思源关闭时工具列表依然可用。

description.en: Enhanced ACP server for DeepSeek Harness: block & reasoning streaming, usage telemetry, model/effort switching, permission presets, session resume/archive,…
description.zh: 增强版 ACP 服务器：块级与推理流式、用量遥测、模型/推理强度切换、权限预设、会话恢复/归档、每会话 MCP servers、Zed 文件/终端转发。

description.en: Provides the see_image tool for DSH: send an image file to a configurable OpenAI-compatible vision model and relay its description back to a text-only model.
description.zh: 为 DSH 提供 see_image 工具：将图片文件发送到可配置的 OpenAI 兼容视觉模型，并把其描述回传给纯文本模型。

description.en: Conversational Grafana operations: inspect live dashboard data across named sources, then make safe, reviewable dashboard changes with approval and version…
description.zh: 对话式 Grafana 运维：跨多个命名源站查看实时大盘数据，再通过审批与版本校验安全、可审阅地修改大盘。

description.en: Conversational Markdown mindmap workspace: edit complete documents step by step, keep a live right-side visualization synchronized, and open, manage, and…
description.zh: 对话式 Markdown 思维脑图工作台：逐步编辑完整文档，实时同步右侧可视化，并在工作目录中打开、管理和导出脑图。

description.en: Claude Code-inspired Auto Memory meets Codex-inspired Session consolidation, bringing simple, transparent, and context-efficient long-term memory to DeepSeek…
description.zh: 融合 Claude Code 的 Auto Memory 与 Codex 的 Session 记忆整理，为 DeepSeek Harness 提供简单、透明、上下文友好的长期记忆。

description.en: Adds per-Workspace category trees to the Web sidebar, with nested categories, drag-and-drop session assignment, category-scoped session creation, and category…
description.zh: 为 Web 侧边栏添加按 Workspace 隔离的分类树，支持嵌套分类、拖拽归类会话、在分类中新建会话，以及删除分类时归档其中的会话。

description.en: General-purpose knowledge base for DSH: import md/txt/json/yml/docx/pdf, folder management, FTS5 full-text search (BM25), and a Web management UI.
description.zh: DSH 通用知识库插件：导入 md/txt/json/yml/docx/pdf、目录化管理、FTS5 全文检索（BM25）、Web 管理界面。

description.en: Persona library for DeepSeek Harness: injects the selected persona into the system prompt, offering three built-ins plus import from a file or pasted text,…
description.zh: 把选中的人设注入系统提示词的 DeepSeek Harness 插件：内置三套人设，支持从文件导入或粘贴自定义人设，并可按 profile 全局生效或按会话单独选择（输入框上方有切换条）。

description.en: User Message Timeline - floating pill rail with hover preview, click/drag jump and pagination, switchable left/right.
description.zh: 对话内悬浮药丸导轨：等距药丸、悬停预览、点击/拖拽跳转、分页自动加载，开关在设置-插件-插件配置。

description.en: Manage global AGENTS.md in DSH Web with Markdown preview, reusable templates, version history, import/export, failed-import rollback, and revision-conflict…
description.zh: 在 DSH Web 中管理全局 AGENTS.md，支持 Markdown 预览、可复用模板、版本历史、导入导出、失败导入回滚与修订冲突保护。

description.en: Renders LaTeX in the chat — formulas inside your own message bubble, plus a live preview of the composer draft while you type.
description.zh: 在聊天里渲染 LaTeX：你自己的消息气泡内联渲染公式，输入时还会实时预览草稿里的公式。

description.en: LaTeX snippet expansion in the composer, built from Obsidian LaTeX Suite's own defaults — 138 triggers expand as they are typed, Tab walks the tabstops, and…
description.zh: 输入框里的 LaTeX 片段展开，触发词表直接取自 Obsidian Latex Suite 的默认片段——138 条打完即出，Tab 依次跳 tabstop，142 条全在一份可编辑的 JSON 里。

description.en: Settings section that reports token usage: totals for input, output, cache read, cache write, reasoning and call count, with breakdowns by model, day, month…
description.zh: 设置中的 Token 用量面板：总量（输入/输出/缓存读/缓存写/推理/调用次数），按模型、按天、按月、按项目的明细，以及最近 30 天的按日趋势折线图；历史在 Worker 线程上一次性重建，之后由会话事件实时累加。

description.en: Novel-writing guardrails: 20 novel_* tools enforce fact-ledger consistency, phase and chapter gates, machine audit with deterministic metrics, and…
description.zh: 小说写作护栏插件：20 个 novel_* 工具以代码强制事实账本一致性、阶段与落盘门禁、确定性机审与提案制修订；右侧栏工作台提供阅读/听书/润色/校对/全书体检/批量起草，旁路引擎让内部工序不占主对话。

description.en: Bilibili-style danmaku overlay for the DSH Web chat area: scroll, top and bottom tracks driven by agent events, three preset packs, optional LLM-generated…

description.en: Omni-modal workstation for DSH: analyze_image over an ordered multi-card VLM failover chain, a six-tool vision toolkit (zoom, colour sampling, pixel diff, OCR,…
description.zh: 面向 DSH 的全模态工作站：analyze_image 走有序多卡片 VLM 故障转移链；六个视觉工具箱工具（局部放大、色调采样、像素比对、OCR、元素检测、内联展示）共用同一套图片来源解析；generate_image 支持 OpenAI/DashScope/ComfyUI 协议；多卡片异步…

description.en: HuaweiCloud DevKit gives AI agents complete command of Huawei Cloud — build, deploy, operate, always governed, always secure.
description.zh: 让 AI 智能体掌握华为云全流程操作——构建、部署、运维全程受控，助您轻松安全上云。

description.en: Gitee Enterprise project management inside the conversation: issues, pull requests, kanban and the Gitee MCP toolchain.
description.zh: 在对话里管理 Gitee 企业版项目：issue、Pull Request、看板与 Gitee MCP 工具链。

description.en: Notification outbox: agent proactively notifies via toast / Chinese TTS voice / sound effects (explosion, victory, alarm), 60s confirmation window voice-calls…
description.zh: 通知出口：agent 主动通过桌面通知 / 中文语音 / 音效（炸裂、胜利、警报）联系你，60 秒确认窗口后语音呼叫，音量增强，设置面板。

description.en: Import claude-code / codex / reasonix / zcode chat history into dsh sessions: workspace binding, tool calls preserved, oversized-session protection, zcode…
description.zh: 把 claude-code / codex / reasonix / zcode 的聊天历史导入为 dsh 会话：工作区绑定、工具调用保留、超长会话保护、zcode 压缩还原。

description.en: Plugin store: npm authoritative catalog + awesome curated list (550+ plugins, 11 categories), dsh-field quality verification, official `dsh plugin add/remove`…
description.zh: dsh 插件商店：npm 权威目录 + awesome 精选（550+ 插件、11 分类）、dsh 字段质量验证、官方 `dsh plugin add/remove` 一键安装，侧边栏与设置页入口。

description.en: Annotates every subagent with the model route it actually ran on: a badge line in each parent-catalog row and a readout in a child session's own header.

description.en: Distill over-long model reasoning into its useful core, replay the compressed version on every later request, and report each session's cost and savings.…
description.zh: 把过长的模型思考压缩成有用核心，之后每次请求重放压缩版，并给出每个会话的开销与节省报告。默认关闭：必须先选择一个改写后端。derive 无需安装、打包版也能用；in-place 需给 DSH 源码打 14 处补丁并重建（源码构建首选）；message-edit 需装第三方插件，仅实验性，不推荐。

description.en: Profile-aware keyboard shortcuts for DSH Web: supports Question and Approval cards, Standard/Vim/Custom profiles, and capability-gated Session and Workspace…

description.en: Configure reasoning-effort levels and sub-agent defaults for custom DSH models.

description.en: Host page for kit plugin configuration in the DSH Web GUI: registers a "Plugin configuration" section in Settings — peer to the built-in General section —…

description.en: Profile management card for the DSH Web GUI: view, create (base / web / headless templates), copy, rename and delete DSH profiles under ~/.dsh/profiles, with…

description.en: Daily RSS/Atom news digest for DSH: built-in channels plus a curated awesome-rsshub-routes catalog and custom feeds (validated on save), aggregated into one…

description.en: In-session "Files" tab (conversation.view, order 20) for dsh Web that browses the active session's workspace directory with breadcrumbs and previews files…
description.zh: dsh Web 会话内「文件」页签（conversation.view，order 20）：以当前会话工作区为根的面包屑目录浏览，内联预览消毒渲染的 Markdown（marked + DOMPurify）、图片、带行号文本与 PDF；目录与读取全部经 ctx.webServer 注册的只读 /dsh-files…

description.en: Workspace-first enhanced sidebar for dsh Web that shadows the built-in workspace browser at low priority (one-click toggle back to the official one) and adds…

description.zh: 把 DSH 工作区暴露为 HTTP API：浏览/搜索/读取文件，并支持自然语言任务（agent 查阅文档后带出处回答）。

description.en: Header quota badge plus a usage-monitoring tab: live balance/quota remaining and reset countdown per provider, with requests, tokens (input/output/cache-read/ca…

description.en: Web-novel writing assistant preset for DeepSeek Harness: the main agent acts as editor-in-chief and delegates outlining, drafting, review, lore-keeping and…
description.zh: 网文创作辅助插件：主 agent 任主编，把大纲、写作、审校、设定维护、素材考据委派给五个帮手，按七阶段工作流推进；整部小说就是工作区里结构化的 novel/ 目录（角色卡、伏笔状态机、时间线、叙事记忆），另带侧栏创作台面板与六条零依赖 CLI 命令。

description.en: Orchestration-mode preset generator for DSH: a lead agent delegates to four built-in role helpers that carry only their own tools, and the web panel adds or…

description.en: A slim port of Headroom: compresses tool output, cuts up to 20% of context, without affecting the model's context cache or agent performance.
description.zh: Headroom 的精简移植，在不影响模型上下文缓存以及 Agent 性能的情况下，压缩工具的输出，至多减少 20% 的上下文。

description.en: Adds Alt+Enter as a newline to the DeepSeek Harness (dsh) web composer.
description.zh: 给 dsh 的网页输入框加上 Alt+Enter 换行。

description.en: Multi-device remote access for DeepSeek Harness: continue an active session from your phone, tablet, browser, or another computer over an end-to-end encrypted…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 多端远程访问：从手机、平板、浏览器或另一台电脑继续进行中的会话，端到端加密通道（Noise IK + 自适应 Relay/WebRTC 传输），设备授权管理；远程端仅开放 ApiProxy 能力，支持 dsh-file-viewer 只读文件预览，不提供…

description.en: Read-only Web client file-preview panel with image, PDF, CSV/TSV, text, source-code, Markdown, JSON and YAML renderers, large-file range loading, and a…

description.en: Question index: an ordered, collapsible list of your asked questions floating on the right side of the conversation; click a question to jump the session to…
description.zh: 提问索引：在会话右侧按序展示你提过的问题列表，可收起；点击某条即可把会话滚动跳转到对应位置。打开会话自动索引全部历史提问并本地持久保存；点击更早的提问会按需翻页加载后跳转。

description.en: Reorder configured models in the composer model picker, set cache-hit, cache-miss and output prices per million tokens, and estimate per-turn and session costs…
description.zh: 在输入框右下角的模型选择器中自定义模型顺序，按每百万 tokens 设置缓存命中、缓存未命中与输出三档价格，并结合内置的 DeepSeek 峰谷价估算逐轮和本会话费用。

description.en: Windows 2000 desktop skin for the DSH Web GUI: metric-accurate grey chrome, two-tone gradient title bars, 1px bevels, square corners, 16px scrollbars, and the…
description.zh: 给 DSH Web GUI 换上 Windows 2000 桌面外观：按度量表还原的灰色控件、双色渐变标题栏、1px 立体边框、直角、16px 滚动条，以及由插件自身路由提供的点阵字体。

description.en: Persistent conversation outline: per-turn questions and final replies, keyword filter, one-click jump, light/full history modes, and Ctrl/Shift+click to open…

description.en: MCP & Skill manager: enable/disable MCP servers and skills from a Settings panel to free context in real time; optional AI middle layer (mcp_search/mcp_call)…

description.en: Recall any user message: rolls the conversation (official session fork) and workspace files (per-message shadow git snapshots) back to before it, with a…
description.zh: 消息撤回：在用户消息旁加「撤回」按钮，把对话历史（官方会话 fork）与项目文件（逐消息影子 git 快照）一并回退到该消息发送之前，带差异预览确认面板。

description.en: Multi-agent team collaboration for DeepSeek Harness with per-assistant models, skills, MCP servers, independent contexts, shared workspaces, task coordination,…
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 提供多 Agent 团队协作，支持助手独立模型、Skills、MCP 服务与上下文，以及共享工作区、任务协调和会话管理。

description.en: AgentDuel is a code-battle game. This plugin lets you complete the entire game loop inside DSH: manage deathmatch characters and capture-the-flag teams, submit…
description.zh: AgentDuel 是一款代码对战游戏，通过这款插件，在 DSH 内部完成整个游戏过程，实现死斗角色与夺旗团队、提交 Agent 代码、发起战斗、观看回放，并通过 DSH 会话依据战果继续优化 Agent。

description.en: Chinese government document processing toolkit: GB/T 9704 format check, auto-fix, content revision (red annotation + strikethrough), template generation,…
description.zh: 中文公文全流程处理工具：GB/T 9704 格式检查、自动修复、内容修订（红色标注+删除线）、模板生成、Markdown 转公文、版头/版记/页码注入，覆盖通知/请示/报告/函/会议纪要等 24 类公文。

description.en: Always-on-top capybara task reporter for DSH Web — a transparent floating pet that narrates each trajectory step in a speech bubble, names the project it…
description.zh: 为 DSH Web 打造的永远置顶的水豚任务播报宠物——透明悬浮气泡逐条播报运行轨迹、标明所属项目，任务完成时提醒正在别处忙碌的你。

description.en: Role-based AI swarms for DeepSeek Harness: an architect plans, parallel builders execute, reviewers gate quality, and an integrator ships. Per-role model…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的角色化 AI 蜂群：架构师规划、多个建造者并行执行、评审代理把关、集成代理收尾。按角色钉选模型（含回退链），支持评审循环、证据合约、人工评审门、配额耗尽自动暂停与恢复，Web GUI 内置实时看板与任务流程图。40 个测试用例；支持 GitHub 或 npm 安装。

description.en: Adds a writing-plans skill that generates a structured implementation plan document before coding, then executes simple tasks inline or offers an execution…
description.zh: 添加 writing-plans 技能，在写代码前生成结构化实现计划文档，简单任务直接执行，复杂任务提供执行方式选择。

description.en: Desktop full-screen boot splash. It covers DSH's loading card before first paint, plays a 4.5 s five-stage compass sequence, then hands off to the app;…

description.en: Runs AItelier pipelines from DSH over MCP: 39 tools (22 read, 17 write) to generate, run, inspect, edit, export and import multi-step SkillFlow pipelines. The…

description.zh: 在会话视图中新增「执行图」标签页，把每个轮次的提问、模型回复与工具调用/结果渲染为可折叠的时间轴，并带详情面板与 PNG 导出。

description.en: A self-evolving plugin for DeepSeek Harness: it observes how the agent runs, proposes improvements to its own assets via the LLM, validates each proposal…

description.en: A developer toolkit for the DeepSeek Harness (DSH) web console: a real multi-tab PTY terminal docked under the composer plus an AI-output file browser sidebar…

description.en: JIRA task panel under the DSH composer: per-workspace project key and optional JQL, listing the issues assigned to the current user with status, priority and…

依据 GB/T 36344-2018 国家标准，从规范性、完整性等六个维度对数据质量进行量化评分，为企业数据资产入表提供可审计的底稿。

description.en: Data lineage tracking tool, mapping the full lifecycle of data to meet source legality requirements.

Shows a reminder card in the bottom-right corner of the DSH web GUI whenever the agent is waiting for your answer, and adds a desktop notification plus a…

description.en: Recalls messages you already sent in the DSH composer with ArrowUp; ArrowDown walks forward, restores the draft you were writing, and one more press discards…

description.zh: 在对话中运行 RunningHub 云端 ComfyUI 工作流：设置卡片、sha256 媒体上传缓存、并发闸门与后台任务台账。

description.en: Token usage statistics for DeepSeek Harness with a session drawer and today / last-3-day / last-7-day panels, plus configurable charts and metrics.
description.zh: 统计 DeepSeek Harness 的 Token 用量：会话抽屉与今日 / 近 3 天 / 近 7 天面板，图表与指标可配置。

description.en: GitHub Copilot LLM adapter: OAuth device-flow sign-in, live model discovery from the Copilot API, vision support for image-capable models (gpt-4.1, gpt-4o),…
description.zh: GitHub Copilot LLM 适配器：OAuth 设备码登录、从 Copilot API 动态发现模型、视觉模型图片输入支持（gpt-4.1、gpt-4o），以及 Chat Completions 与 Responses 双协议，按模型自动路由。

description.en: Global cross-session todo inbox for DSH web: any session's agent records human-action todos (merge MRs, approve work orders, reviews) via…
description.zh: DSH Web 全局跨会话待办收件箱：任意会话的 agent 通过 inbox_add/inbox_done/inbox_list 登记等待人类处理的事项（合并 MR、审批工单、评审等）；侧边栏入口显示未完成数角标与可展开的待办列表，支持打开与完成，数据持久化到 ~/.dsh/todo-inbox.json。

description.en: DeepSeek wallet balance at the sidebar foot: a credit-card icon with the amount tinted by remaining balance (green over ¥2, amber ¥0–2, red below), refreshed…
description.zh: 侧边栏底部的 DeepSeek 钱包余额：信用卡图标配余额数字，按剩余额度着色（≥ ¥2 绿色、¥0–2 黄色、≤ ¥0 红色），挂载时、每轮对话结束和点击时刷新；余额变动时带符号差额上飘淡出。

description.en: Runs a parallel code review squad of read-only reviewer subagents (security, correctness, tests, style), each optionally on its own model, and aggregates one…
description.zh: 通过 /review 命令或 code_review 工具并行派出只读评审员子代理小队（安全、正确性、测试、风格，各自可指定不同模型），并汇总为按严重度分组的结构化评审报告。

description.en: Restart the whole DeepSeek Harness desktop app from five entry points (sidebar panel, sidebar footer, conversation title bar, /restart-desktop slash command,…
description.zh: 从五个入口（侧栏面板、侧栏底部、会话标题栏、/restart-desktop 斜杠命令、设置页）经分离的 helper 结束并重新拉起 Electron 主进程，重启整个 DeepSeek Harness 桌面应用，而不是只重启 dsh web 进程；插件正在安装/更新且 pnpm 还活着时硬拦重启，清理 DSH…

description.en: Picks a random installed skin on every DeepSeek Harness launch and enables exactly that skin, with an on/off switch and a shuffle action inside the Skins…
description.zh: 每次启动 DeepSeek Harness 时随机启用一个已安装皮肤，并在「设置 → 皮肤」页内提供开关与「立即随机换一个」按钮。宿主会拒绝加载的皮肤自动排除；手动切换的皮肤一直有效到下次启动。

description.en: Agent governance kingdom for DeepSeek Harness: territories, role bindings (bind/unbind/session with model/agent identity), and a plan→assign→execute→review…
description.zh: DSH 里的 Agent 王国：领地、角色绑定/换届/会话归属（含模型/Agent 身份），plan→派发→执行→验收治理闭环（Worker 自述≠完成事实），附本地 GUI 操作台。

description.en: HTTP/API debugging toolset: full-control HTTP requests (method/headers/body/auth), curl command parsing and one-step execution, in-session request history with…
description.zh: HTTP/API 调试工具集：全参数 HTTP 请求（method/headers/body/auth）、curl 命令解析与一步执行、会话内请求历史与响应并排对比、分页 Link 头透出；配合可选 dsh-http-tools-ui 提供 DeepSeek 风格工具卡片。

description.en: A polished floating whale desktop pet for the DeepSeek Harness Web UI with 95 categorized transparent animations, state-aware event reactions, customizable…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web UI 的精致悬浮鲸鱼桌宠，拥有 95 个分类透明动画、状态感知事件回应、可自定义动作与触发规则，并支持点击互动、拖拽和屏幕漫游。

description.en: Adds a session-scoped context window selector next to the reasoning-effort row in the DeepSeek Harness model popup: a pill showing the effective window opens a…
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 模型弹窗的「推理等级」旁增加会话级上下文窗口选择器：显示当前生效窗口的胶囊按钮可展开默认窗口以下的档位下拉，选择只作用于该会话的下一次请求，新建会话自动回到 Profile 默认值。不改任何配置文件，也不向会话日志写入内容。

description.en: Telegram duty gateway: phone-message task loop on a dedicated duty session, global approval forwarding with inline approve/reject buttons, telegram_ask choice…
description.zh: Telegram 值班网关：手机消息任务闭环（专属值班会话）、值守模式全局审批转发（内联同意/拒绝按钮）、telegram_ask 选项提问、值守/本地切换与网页横幅、中英双语消息、空闲零 token。

description.en: Packaging pipeline for uni-app x projects: reads the local HBuilderX version, recommends and one-click installs the matching iOS / Android / HarmonyOS offline…
description.zh: uni-app x 项目打包流水线：读取本机 HBuilderX 版本，按版本推荐并一键配置对应的 iOS / Android / HarmonyOS 离线 SDK（面板卡片附官方下载入口），再按项目配置调用 HBuilderX CLI 打出、签名并上传；引擎同时以 list / doctor / check /…

description.en: Manage the dsh service via `dsh --profile ctl`: systemd lifecycle (install, start, stop, restart, enable, disable, uninstall), persisted config, health probe…
description.zh: 通过 `dsh --profile ctl` 管理 DSH 服务：systemd 生命周期（安装、启停、重启、自启、卸载）、持久化配置、健康探测与日志，附带 shell 补全与自更新。

description.en: Sends a desktop notification and chime when a DeepSeek Harness run completes, errors, or waits for approval, with a configurable duration threshold.
description.zh: DSH 桌面通知插件：运行完成、出错或等待审批时发送桌面通知并播放提示音，支持可配置的时长阈值。

description.en: Visual theme customizer for the DeepSeek Harness web UI — backgrounds, text colors, borders and details, all adjustable visually, with presets you can import…
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness Web 界面自定义主题插件：背景/文字/框线/细节全可视化调整，可导入导出预设，持久化保存。

description.en: Chrome and Edge browser control that drives the real logged-in profile, tabs and cookies through an MV3 extension and a loopback Bridge, exposing browser_*…
description.zh: 通过 MV3 扩展和本地 loopback Bridge 驱动用户已登录的真实 Chrome/Edge Profile、标签页与 Cookie，为 DSH 提供 browser_* 工具、Skill 和 /chrome 命令。

description.en: Project file explorer in the details column (multi-select, drag-move, upload, download, rename, trash, system-open) with an in-session read-only preview tab…
description.zh: DSH 右侧 details 列项目资源管理器（多选、拖拽移动、上传、下载、重命名、废纸篓、系统打开），会话内只读预览 Markdown/HTML/JSON/CSV/Notebook/PDF 与代码高亮，附带模型实时吞吐徽标与多行 GoalBar。

description.en: Adds a live status badge to the session header and delivers guidance added mid-task without interrupting the turn.
description.zh: 在会话头显示实时状态徽标，并在不打断当前回合的前提下投递运行中新增的指导。

description.en: Gives DSH the full 33-tool browser surface (ctx.browser seam -> a self-hosted headless Chromium over CDP: one 127.0.0.1 daemon with Bearer-token auth,…
description.zh: 为 DSH 挂出完整的浏览器工具面（33 个 browser_* 工具）：把 ctx.browser 接缝接到自管的 headless Chromium（经 127.0.0.1 单例 CDP 守护进程，带 Bearer token 鉴权、请求路径白名单与 WebSocket 地址改写，不需要 root / GUI 库…

description.en: Gives DSH the full 33-tool browser surface (ctx.browser seam -> a self-hosted headless moli browser over CDP: one 127.0.0.1 daemon with Bearer-token auth,…
description.zh: 为 DSH 挂出完整的浏览器工具面（33 个 browser_* 工具）：把 ctx.browser 接缝接到自管的 moli 无头浏览器（经 127.0.0.1 单例 CDP 守护进程，带 Bearer token 鉴权、请求路径白名单与 WebSocket 地址改写，不需要 root / GUI 库 /…

description.en: Auto-renames DSH sessions with LLM-summarized titles: runs after the first prompt and on /handoff, or manually via a header button or /autotitle, with…
description.zh: DSH 会话自动重命名（session rename）：基于全部会话消息的 LLM 总结标题，首条提示词与 /handoff 后自动命名，会话头按钮或 /autotitle 手动触发，标题语言与最大字节数可设置。

description.en: Custom brand icon and name for the DSH Web sidebar and conversation hero, editable live from a settings card on the plugin detail page.
description.zh: 自定义 DSH Web 侧边栏与会话页的品牌图标和名称，插件详情页内置设置卡片，保存即生效。

description.en: AI companion with a learned body clock, real offline sleep, its own memory, and self-reported affect delivered through the same judge math as the pi version.
description.zh: 有生物钟、会真实睡觉、有自己的记忆和情绪的 AI 伴侣，主动冲动以独立 turn 投递。

description.en: Rotates configured LLM API keys after quota, rate-limit, or authentication failures.
description.zh: 在配额、速率限制或身份验证失败后轮换已配置的 LLM API 密钥。

description.en: Wraps colbymchenry/codegraph into agent tools - status, search, callers/callees, impact, explore, and more.
description.zh: 将 colbymchenry/codegraph 封装到代理工具中 - status、search、callers/callees、impact、explore 等等。

description.en: Generates UI wireframes and high-fidelity mockups in DeepSeek Harness with selectable DashScope and Volcengine image providers.
description.zh: 在 DeepSeek Harness 中使用可切换的阿里云百炼与火山方舟图像服务生成 UI 线框图和高保真设计稿。

description.en: Trims historical images in outgoing chat requests down to a recent-image count, learns the provider per-prompt image cap from HTTP 400 responses, and retries…
description.zh: 发送前把请求中的历史图片裁剪至保留张数，并从上游 400 错误解析单次图片上限、按更少张数降级重试，保证含图会话不被图片数量限制打断。

description.en: Route agent network requests through a local HTTP/CONNECT/SOCKS5 proxy.
description.zh: 让 agent 的网络请求走本机 HTTP/CONNECT/SOCKS5 代理。

description.en: UI enhancement suite for the DSH web client: Chinese locale completion, one-row stats, auto-expanded thinking, chat width, session archiving and delete, plus…
description.zh: DSH 网页 UI 综合增强：中文补全、统计单行显示、思考自动展开、对话宽度、会话归档与删除，并可选的提示词注入（默认关闭）。

description.en: Zhipu (GLM Coding Plan) web suite as native DSH providers and tools: rebinds the built-in web_search and web_fetch to Zhipu web search and Markdown page…
description.zh: 智谱（GLM Coding Plan）三件套以原生 provider 与工具接入：内置 web_search / web_fetch 后端切换为智谱联网搜索与网页 Markdown 读取，可选注册 github_search_doc / github_get_repo_structure /…

description.en: Doubao-style voice chat for DSH: press-and-hold mic in the composer converts speech to text and auto-sends, and AI replies are read aloud. Optional LLM…
description.zh: 豆包式语音对话插件：聊天框麦克风按钮（按住说话）语音转文字并自动发送，AI 回复自动朗读。可选 LLM 转述精简（长回复压缩成口语再播，跟随当前对话模型）、朗读前清洗 markdown/emoji/特殊符号、Edge TTS 多种音色、静音自动结束时长可调，设置嵌入 DSH 自带设置弹窗（voice chat 类目）。

description.en: Overleaf-style LaTeX paper workbench: annotate any text in the rendered PDF and let a dsh agent revise the sources with compile checks and git history.
description.zh: Overleaf 式 LaTeX 论文工作台：在渲染后的 PDF 上选中任意文字批注，由 dsh agent 改写源文件、编译验证并提交 git 修订。

description.en: Hosted tool server over MCP: invoice and bank-statement extraction with in-code arithmetic checks, ledger reconciliation in integer cents, PDF and table…
description.zh: 托管工具服务器（MCP）：发票与银行流水提取并做代码内算术校验、按整数分对账、PDF 与表格转换、SQL 方言转写，以及从中国移动骨干网实测大陆可达性。

description.en: Multi-agent orchestration agent preset for DeepSeek Harness: one chief orchestrator that never implements itself — it triages every request, has a PM expert…
description.zh: 多智能体编排 agent preset：首席编排者不亲自实施——先分诊、请 PM 专家规划、经合并专家花名册（召唤工具）把实施委派给领域专家，依赖 DAG 任务板与落盘消息总线调度并行协作，交付前经独立评审门禁。出厂内置 11 位核心专家；更多专家团（Agency agents 中英文、classic…

description.en: QQ channel for dsh via OneBot 11 (NapCat and friends): reverse or forward WebSocket, DM and group chats, image and voice transcription, t2i text-image cards,…
description.zh: 给 dsh 加上 QQ 通道（OneBot 11，兼容 NapCat）：反向/正向 WS、私聊群聊、图片与语音转写、t2i 文字图卡片、合并转发、设置页可视化配置。

description.en: Connects Qoder (China and Global) subscriptions to DSH through personal access tokens, keeping each variant on its own credentials and catalog, with…
description.zh: 通过个人访问令牌将 Qoder（国内版与国际版）接入 DSH，两版各自独立的凭证与模型目录，支持多令牌切换、侧栏额度卡、按模型开关、上下文窗口偏好与每日自动签到。

description.en: DSH QQ bot bridge plugin, connect DeepSeek Harness with QQ bot.
description.zh: DSH QQ机器人桥接插件，将DeepSeek Harness对接QQ机器人。

description.en: DSH Prompt Library plugin: prompt CRUD, tags & categories, import/export, AI polish, one-click clip selected text, sidebar and assistant bubble reminders.
description.zh: DSH提示词库插件：支持提示词增删改查、分类标签、导入导出、AI智能优化、选中文本一键剪藏，附带侧边栏与词库助手气泡提醒。

description.en: Read-only Gitea and Forgejo tools over the REST API both projects share: instance info, repository listing, issue and pull request search and read, PR diffs…
description.zh: 面向自建 Gitea / Forgejo 的只读工具，走两者共用的 REST API：实例信息、仓库列表、议题与 PR 搜索和读取、PR diff 与变更文件，以及 Actions 运行、任务与任务日志。工具元数据支持英文、繁体中文、简体中文与日文。

description.en: Read-only Grafana tools that query metrics through the data source proxy: instance health, data source listing, instant and range PromQL queries, current alert…
description.zh: 面向 Grafana 的只读工具，经数据源代理查询指标：实例健康、数据源列表、instant 与 range PromQL 查询、当前告警状态与已配置的告警规则。range 查询会按点数预算降采样；调用方显式指定的 step 若会超量则直接拒绝，而不是静默改写，避免模型拿到与预期不同分辨率的数据。

description.en: Read-only Odoo tools over JSON-RPC: server info, model field introspection, and a restricted search_read limited to an allow list of models whose domain field…
description.zh: 经 JSON-RPC 的 Odoo 只读工具：服务器信息、模型字段自省，以及受限的 search_read——仅限白名单模型，且 domain 字段名不允许包含点号，因此无法沿关联关系穿透。草稿创建工具需显式开启 allowWrite 才会注册，且仅限 sale.order 与…

description.en: Read-only Sentry tools: project listing, issue search at organization or project scope, single issue detail, and the latest or a specific event with a trimmed…
description.zh: 面向 Sentry 的只读工具：项目列表、组织或项目范围的议题搜索、单个议题详情，以及最新或指定 event 的裁剪后堆栈。局部变量、请求头与请求体、查询字符串、依赖清单以及疑似机密的 tag 会在 event 交给模型前移除；超大 event 会依次降级源码上下文、面包屑与栈帧，而不是直接失败。

description.en: Read-only SonarQube Community Build tools: instance status, project Quality Gate for a branch or pull request, issue and Security Hotspot search, single…
description.zh: 面向 SonarQube Community Build 的只读工具：实例状态、分支或 PR 的项目质量阈、议题与安全热点搜索、单个热点详情，以及覆盖率、重复率或调用方指定的度量项。议题与热点结果附带标准化的位置信息，包含组件 key、文件路径、行号与文本范围。

description.en: TinyFish-backed web search provider for the built-in web_search tool: each search is one GET to the TinyFish Search API, no model call.
description.zh: 基于 TinyFish 的网页搜索提供方：把内置 web_search 接到 TinyFish Search API，每次搜索一次 GET，不消耗模型调用。

description.en: Git integration for DSH modelled on IDEA's VCS: a git icon beside the permission mode in the composer shows the current branch and the pending-change count,…
description.zh: 照着 IDEA 的 VCS 做的 Git 集成，装进 DSH 会话：输入框「权限模式」旁边的 Git 图标显示当前分支与未提交改动数，悬停可切分支，点击弹出 IDEA 风格的面板（分支树、提交图、变更与暂存、提交详情、文件差异），另有一个设置页管提交身份、git 位置和网络参数。不向 DSH 注册任何模型工具。

description.en: Personal workbench panel with an overview dashboard, custom kanban boards, a note pad and a file library, persisted to local JSON by the host.
description.zh: 个人工作台面板：总览仪表盘、自定义看板、随手记与资料库，数据由 Host 持久化到本地 JSON。

description.en: A Mimi desktop companion for DSH that follows work-session states with animated reactions and bubbles, provides a separate chat mode, and bundles Windows…
description.zh: DSH 的 Mimi 桌面伴侣，跟随工作会话状态显示动画反应和气泡，提供独立聊天模式，并内置 Windows Computer Use 以观察和操作桌面窗口。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness integration for OpenContext with durable cross-session memory, automatic prompt capture and recall, session summaries, structured insights,…
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 接入 OpenContext，提供跨会话持久记忆、提示词自动捕获与召回、会话摘要、结构化洞察和文档检索。

description.en: Modifies DSH plugin code at runtime, with ordered patches, inspection, and hot reload.
description.zh: 在运行时修改 DSH 插件代码，并提供 Patch 排序、检查和热重载。

description.en: DeepSeek Harness memory and knowledge hub that routes update, retrieve, and subscribe calls across compatible plugins, with an optional transactional Rust…
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的记忆与知识中台：在兼容插件之间路由 update、retrieve 和 subscribe 调用，并提供可选的事务化 Rust 后端。

description.en: Visual development studio for DSH WebUI plugins with isolated Git worktrees, live official-WebUI previews, source editing, patch inspection, builds, and…
description.zh: 面向 DSH WebUI 插件的可视化开发工作室，提供隔离的 Git worktree、真实官方 WebUI 预览、源码编辑、Patch 检查、构建与验证。

description.en: Memory Lake as a persistent memory layer for dsh: memory_search, memory_remember, and memory_forget tools over the memorylake CLI, a session status line, and…
description.zh: 将 Memory Lake 作为 dsh 的持久记忆层：基于 memorylake CLI 的 memory_search、memory_remember、memory_forget 三个工具，会话状态行，以及引导安装/诊断 skills，与 Claude Code、Codex 插件共享同一…

description.en: Lightweight Markdown conversation theme plugin — enhances native color scheme with 4 built-in themes (light/dark dual), user-defined CSS themes, system-aware…
description.zh: 轻量级对话 Markdown 主题插件——增强原生着色，4 套内置主题（浅/深双档）、用户自定义 CSS 主题、系统感知自动切换、内置主题编辑器，提升快速阅读体验。

description.en: Replaces the web profile's pwsh shell executor with a subclass that rewrites every command through `rtk rewrite` before execution for token savings, running…
description.zh: 将 web profile 的 pwsh shell 执行器替换为执行前经 `rtk rewrite` 透明改写的子类以节省 token，任何改写失败（无等价、rtk 缺失、超时）都原样执行且沙箱语义完整保留。

description.en: Chat-operated multi-database admin plugin for DeepSeek Harness: query and manage MySQL, PostgreSQL, GaussDB, MongoDB, Redis, Oracle, DM and SQLite from the…

description.en: Model-directed context compaction for PTC mode, grouping program runs into blocks and replacing completed block messages with model-written summaries.

description.en: Scene-awareness probe for DSH on macOS: a privacy-first, pull-model `look` tool that reads the frontmost non-self window (app info, AX title/selection, gated…

description.en: A self-healing layer for tool calls: missing params, wrong fields and out-of-range paths are fixed before they reach the model. Measured visible error rate…

description.en: Version badge above the sidebar settings button: shows the current dsh version, expands to list every core package version, and checks npm for updates with…

description.en: Collapses consecutive tool-use and thinking steps between messages into a single bracketed, expandable item.
description.zh: 把消息之间连续的工具调用与思考步骤折叠成单个可展开的括号条目。

description.zh: 「设置」按钮上方的一键二维码，让手机通过带鉴权的反向代理连接 Web 界面。

description.en: Mobile adaptation for the DSH Web UI: works well on narrow screens, fits wide screens too.
description.zh: DSH Web UI 移动端适配：窄屏好用，宽屏适用。

description.en: Native-feel DSH attachments: official PNG/JPEG/WebP/GIF thumbs plus 64px cards for other files via drag, paste, or paperclip; non-images land in .dsh-uploads…

description.en: GitHub sidebar workbench for DSH: remote tree plus Issues, Pull requests and Actions tabs, with create/comment/edit/close, merge/squash/rebase, and rerun or…
description.zh: DSH 侧边栏 GitHub 工作台：远端目录树加 Issues / Pull requests / Actions 页签，支持建 Issue/PR、评论、编辑、关闭、merge/squash/rebase 与重跑或取消 CI；挂载为 better-sidebar 页签或独立右侧面板。

description.en: DSH knowledge-graph memory with a better-sidebar tab and a standalone /graph-memory/app dashboard: extracts TASK/SKILL/EVENT nodes, recalls across sessions,…

description.en: Server card dashboard for DSH: per-host status, CPU, memory, disk and latency, with one-click xterm.js SSH terminals; imports ~/.ssh/config and mounts as a…
description.zh: DSH 服务器卡片仪表盘：每台主机展示在线状态、CPU、内存、磁盘与延迟，点卡片进入 xterm.js SSH 终端；支持导入 ~/.ssh/config，挂载为 better-sidebar 页签或独立右侧抽屉。

description.en: Generative background music while the model streams, plus completion, approval and attention chimes: hear whether the agent is thinking, still working, or…

description.en: DSH Desktop enhancement: one-click update checker, DeepSeek balance & API key viewer, and import other AI tools.
description.zh: DSH Desktop 桌面增强：一键检查更新、DeepSeek 余额与 API Key、导入其他 AI 工具。

description.en: A Windows desktop pet for DeepSeek Harness — launch, stop and monitor the DSH service and summon the GUI with a whale.
description.zh: DeepSeek Harness 的鲸鱼娘桌面宠物，一键启动/停止/监测服务，双击唤起 GUI。

description.en: Adds 20 locales (Traditional Chinese HK/TW, Japanese, Korean, French, German, Spanish, Portuguese, Italian, Russian, Ukrainian, Polish, Dutch, Turkish, Arabic,…
description.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 界面新增 20 种语言（繁体中文香港/台湾、日语、韩语、法语、德语、西班牙语、葡萄牙语、意大利语、俄语、乌克兰语、波兰语、荷兰语、土耳其语、阿拉伯语、印地语、印尼语、越南语、泰语、瑞典语），逐条精译并带运行时兜底，另加自动翻译，把市场与第三方文本翻译成你的语言。

description.en: Connect dsh to a local Obsidian vault: search, read, write, move, and trash notes through `obsidian_*` tools.
description.zh: 把 dsh 连接到本地 Obsidian vault：通过 `obsidian_*` 工具搜索、读取、写入、移动与回收笔记。

description.en: Turns stock names and codes in DSH output text into clickable buttons for quotes and company news.
description.zh: 将 DSH 输出文本中的股票名称和代码转换为可点击按钮，并在侧边栏展示行情与资讯。

description.en: Sidebar activity bell: a red badge counts sessions that finished, and clicking it swaps the sidebar list from workspace grouping to a day-grouped…
description.zh: 侧边栏活动铃铛：会话跑完后铃铛显示红色角标，点一下把工作区列表换成按天分组的最近活动列表，尚未打开过的完成项带绿点。

description.en: Browse, enable, disable, and manage Agent Skills from Claude Code, Codex, OpenCode, Gemini, and custom directories in the DSH settings panel.
description.zh: 在 DSH 设置面板中浏览、启用、停用和管理来自 Claude Code、Codex、OpenCode、Gemini 及自定义目录的 Agent Skills。

description.en: Browser automation for DSH: the agent fills in forms, scrapes lists and works across tabs in real pages, using the logins you already have. It drives its own…
description.zh: 浏览器自动化：让 AI 用你已经登录的账号，在真实网页上填表、抓取列表、多标签查后台。它跑在你桌面上的一个可见窗口里 —— 最小化它就不抢焦点、安静干活；遇到登录、验证码和原生弹窗会停下来等你，绝不替你点「确定」。登录一次一直记得（独立 profile + session cookie 回注）。23 个…

description.en: E-commerce product image generation for DSH: 24 prompt modules covering main, detail and ad images, style transfer from a reference shot, batch runs, and a…

description.en: A fiction-writing workbench for DSH with chapter editing, shared plot canvases, grouped character and world settings, writing presets, and scoped import/export…
description.zh: 催更姬：DSH 小说写作工作台，支持章节编辑、共享剧情画布、人物与世界设定分组、写作预设和按范围导入导出，供作者与 AI 一起讨论和推进故事。

description.en: Goal lifecycle management for dsh with an interactive kanban board: goals, criteria, attempts and reviews live in the workspace, driven by graph_* tools, with…

description.en: Search, monitor, interrupt, and batch-archive workspace subagents, featuring real-time activity streaming and an active-agent floating panel.
description.zh: 搜索、监控、打断与批量归档工作区子代理，支持实时活动/思考流式展示与活跃浮窗。

description.en: Connects Qoder subscriptions to DeepSeek Harness, supporting Global and China regions, multimodal input, and tool calls.
description.zh: 将 Qoder 订阅接入 DeepSeek Harness，支持国际版与中国区、多模态与工具调用。

description.en: Alibaba Open Code Review for DSH: host-model delegation with native preview/rule tools and a review skill, plus optional OCR-managed reviews.

description.en: Tavily search, extract, map and crawl tools with multi-key rotation, failover on HTTP 401/429/432/433, and a load-balance mode that caps in-flight requests per…
description.zh: Tavily 搜索、提取、站点地图与爬取工具：多 Key 轮换，HTTP 401/429/432/433 故障转移，并提供按账号限制并发请求的负载均衡模式；插件配置页含密钥与用量卡片。内置 web_search 永不替换。

description.en: Recoverable file and Git operations for coding agents, with shared recovery and redaction tools, a DSH shell adapter and audit records; optional native…

description.en: Media and vision workspace for DeepSeek Harness: image, video and speech generation, image Q&A and element locating, long-image OCR, pixel diff,…
description.zh: 面向 DeepSeek Harness 的媒体与视觉工作台：文生图、图/文生视频、语音合成与转写、图像问答与元素定位、长图 OCR、像素比对、HTML 截图验证、视频摘要；支持 DashScope 与 OpenAI 兼容供应商，含模型池与工作台客户端。

description.en: Let DeepSeek Harness see and operate any program on Windows. The model looks at the real screen and drives the mouse, keyboard and windows itself. It is fast:…

description.zh: 飞书/Lark 深度通道：原生思考过程消息、审批卡片、goal/todo 实时卡片、workflow 展开行、会话全文检索、后台任务与子代理结算通知。其设计以飞书应用自身的可见性范围为访问边界——凡是应用允许触达的人都能驱动 agent 并回答它的审批请求，除非填写可选的发送者/群组/审批人白名单收窄。

description.en: Context fullness bands, the per-session compaction threshold derived from the model window, per-step cost computed from cache read and cache write rates,…
